Its Networking Platforms, including its Optical Networking portfolio and Routing and Switching portfolio, are solutions applied from the network core to end user access points and allow network operators to scale capacity, increase transmission speeds, allocate traffic efficiently, and adapt dynamically to changing end-user service demands, complemented by Platform Software, which delivers multi-layer domain control and operations for network operators, and Blue Planet Automation Software, which enables service providers to rapidly automate critical network functions.

The Cincinnati Insurance Company was founded by four independent insurance agents, and 2025 marked 75 years in business. Cincinnati Financial Corporation is a regulated holding company that transacts substantially all of its business through its subsidiaries, and through The Cincinnati Insurance Company it is one of the 25 largest property casualty insurers in the nation based on net written premium volume, among more than 2,000 U.S. stock and mutual companies. The mission established by its founders continues to guide the company: to grow profitably and enhance the ability of local independent insurance agents to deliver quality financial protection to the people and businesses they serve by providing insurance market stability through financial strength, producing competitive, up-to-date products and services, and developing associates committed to superior service. At year-end 2025 a select group of independent agencies in 46 states actively marketed its property casualty insurance within their communities.

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a caring, innovative growth company united behind its purpose to reimagine a healthier future for all people, their pets and our planet. To achieve its business and financial objectives and deliver peer-leading performance and total shareholder return it is focused on driving organic sales growth, delivering consistent compounded earnings per share growth, achieving operational efficiencies, and driving growth in free cash flow along with the efficient use of its balance sheet. It does this by leveraging the global reach and penetration of its brands, building the incremental benefit of superior, science-based innovation supported by an agile and resilient supply chain, harnessing the power of best-in-class omni-channel demand generation, leading in capabilities such as data, analytics and artificial intelligence, and evolving its high-impact, inclusive culture, and its products are marketed in over 200 countries and territories.

The Clorox Company is a leading multinational manufacturer and marketer of consumer and professional products, with fiscal year 2026 net sales of $6.7 billion and about 9,200 employees worldwide as of June 30, 2026, operations in approximately 25 countries or territories and sales in approximately 95 markets primarily through mass retailers, grocery outlets, warehouse clubs, dollar stores, home hardware centers, drug, pet and military stores, third-party and owned e-commerce channels and distributors. It markets some of the most trusted and recognized consumer brand names, including Clorox cleaning and disinfecting products, Pine-Sol cleaner, Liquid-Plumr clog removers, Poett home care products, Glad bags and wraps, Fresh Step cat litter, Kingsford grilling products, Hidden Valley dressings, dips, seasonings and sauces, Brita water-filtration products and Burt's Bees natural personal care products, and it also markets industry-leading products and technologies for professional customers.

Comcast Corporation is a global media and technology company that reaches customers, viewers and guests worldwide through the connectivity and platforms services it provides and the content and experiences it creates. It delivers broadband, wireless, video and voice services primarily under the Xfinity, Comcast Business, Sky and NOW brands, produces, distributes and streams leading entertainment, sports and news through brands including NBC, Telemundo, Universal, Peacock and Sky, and owns and operates Universal theme parks. It operates two primary businesses, Connectivity & Platforms, which contains its broadband, wireless, video and wireline voice businesses in the United States, United Kingdom and Italy along with the operations of its Sky-branded entertainment television networks in the United Kingdom and Italy and is reported in the Residential Connectivity & Platforms and Business Services Connectivity segments, and Content & Experiences, which contains its media and entertainment businesses.

CME Group enables clients to trade futures, options, cash and over-the-counter products, optimize portfolios and analyze data, empowering market participants worldwide to efficiently manage risk and capture opportunities. It provides primary price discovery and referential pricing information through its market data in a variety of formats, including real-time, historical and derived data for customers in both listed and cash products, offers industry-leading research and analytics tools to provide customers with market education resources, and operates one of the world's leading central counterparty clearing providers. Its principal executive offices are located at 20 South Wacker Drive in Chicago, Illinois, its exchanges offer the widest range of global benchmark products across interest rates, equity indexes, foreign exchange and other asset classes, and its products are traded primarily through the CME Globex electronic trading system, as well as by open outcry in Chicago for SOFR options and through privately negotiated transactions.

Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc., a Delaware corporation, together with its subsidiaries owns and operates Chipotle Mexican Grill restaurants, which feature a relevant menu of burritos, burrito bowls, quesadillas, tacos and salads. It strives to cultivate a better world by serving responsibly sourced, classically cooked real food with wholesome ingredients and without artificial colors, flavors or preservatives, and its first Chipotle restaurant opened in Denver, Colorado in 1993. As of December 31, 2025 it owned 3,938 Chipotle restaurants throughout the United States and 104 international Chipotle restaurants, and it maintains a limited list of approved suppliers, many of whom are among the top suppliers in the industry, along with small grower support during on-site audits, supplier intervention steps to mitigate food safety risks and ingredient traceability.

Cummins Inc., founded in 1919 as Cummins Engine Company in Columbus, Indiana as one of the first diesel engine manufacturers and renamed Cummins Inc. in 2001, is a global power leader committed to powering a more prosperous world. Since 1919 it has delivered innovative solutions that move people, goods and economies forward, and its five reportable segments, Engine, Components, Distribution, Power Systems and Accelera, offer a broad portfolio including advanced diesel, electric and hybrid powertrains, integrated power generation systems, critical components such as aftertreatment, turbochargers, fuel systems, controls, transmissions, axles and brakes, and zero emissions technologies like battery and electric powertrain systems, with a global footprint, deep technical expertise and an extensive service network supporting customers through the energy transition with its Destination Zero strategy.

CMS Energy was formed as a corporation in Michigan in 1987 and is an energy company operating primarily in Michigan. It is the parent holding company of several subsidiaries, including Consumers, an electric and gas utility, and NorthStar Clean Energy, primarily a domestic independent power producer and marketer. The Consumers customer base consists of a mix of primarily residential, commercial and diversified industrial customers, and NorthStar Clean Energy, through its subsidiaries and equity investments, is engaged in domestic independent power production, including the development and operation of renewable generation, and the marketing of independent power production. CMS Energy manages its businesses by the nature of services each provides and operates principally in three business segments: electric utility, gas utility, and NorthStar Clean Energy, its nonutility operations and investments, with the Consumers consolidated operations accounting for the substantial majority of its total assets, income and operating revenue.

Centene Corporation's mission is to transform the health of the communities it serves, one person at a time, and as the nation's largest managed care company focused on underserved populations it offers affordable and high-quality products to more than 1 in 15 individuals across the nation, including Medicaid and Medicare members including Medicare Prescription Drug Plans, as well as individuals and families served by the Health Insurance Marketplace. It provides access to high-quality healthcare, innovative programs and a wide range of health solutions that help families and individuals get well, stay well and be well, believing the best way to deliver healthcare is with a personal approach, with local brands and local teams that live in, care about and directly influence the communities they serve, and its state-based plans are built on community expertise and backed by the depth, breadth and experience of a leading national organization.

CenterPoint Energy is a public utility holding company whose operating subsidiaries own and operate electric transmission, distribution and generation facilities and natural gas distribution systems, and as a holding company it derives all of its operating income from, and holds substantially all of its assets through, its subsidiaries, so that it depends on the performance of and distributions from those subsidiaries to meet its payment obligations and to pay dividends on its common stock. This combined Form 10-K is filed separately by three registrants, CenterPoint Energy, Inc., CenterPoint Energy Houston Electric, LLC and CenterPoint Energy Resources Corp., and Houston Electric is a transmission and distribution electric utility that operates wholly within the state of Texas and does not make direct retail or wholesale sales of electric energy or own or operate any power generating facilities other than TEEEF.

Capital One Financial Corporation, a Delaware corporation established in 1994 and headquartered in McLean, Virginia, is a diversified financial services holding company with banking and non-banking subsidiaries that operates as a global payments provider and diversified financial institution, delivering a broad array of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients through digital channels, branch locations, cafés and other distribution channels. As of December 31, 2025 its principal operating subsidiary was Capital One, National Association, and on May 18, 2025 Discover Financial Services merged into Capital One and Discover Bank merged into Capital One, National Association. Its common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol COF and is included in the S&P 100 Index.

Coherent Corp. is a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops, manufactures and markets lasers, transceivers and other optical and optoelectronic devices, modules and systems, as well as engineered materials, for use in the data center, communications and industrial markets, with its headquarters located in Saxonburg, Pennsylvania. It employed approximately 51,478 people, of which about 89 percent were in manufacturing, 6 percent in research and development and 5 percent in sales, general and administrative roles.

Coinbase Global, Inc., which was initially incorporated in May 2012 as Coinbase, Inc. and converted to a Texas corporation in December 2025, is the parent company of Coinbase, Inc. and a number of other operating subsidiaries, and describes itself as a remote-first company whose majority of employees work remotely and which therefore does not maintain a headquarters. It offers products primarily to three customer groups: Consumers, which are retail customers seeking to hold, invest or trade crypto assets as well as a growing set of trading offerings such as equities, prediction markets and derivatives; Institutions, including market makers, asset managers, hedge funds, banks, wealth platforms, registered investment advisors, payment platforms and corporations, which use its products to custody and trade crypto or crypto derivatives; and Developers, including technology companies, financial institutions and payment firms that leverage the Base Chain and Coinbase Developer Platform. Its platform serves as a secure and compliant on-ramp to the onchain economy, and its business consists of products monetized through transaction fees as well as subscription products such as its stablecoin products.

The Cooper Companies, Inc., headquartered in San Ramon, California, is a leading global medical device company focused on helping people experience life's beautiful moments, selling products in over 130 countries and positively impacting over fifty million lives each year. It operates through two business segments, CooperVision and CooperSurgical, which elevate standards of care with products and services in the fields of vision, fertility and women's health. CooperVision is a global manufacturer providing products for contact lens wearers, developing, manufacturing and marketing a broad range of single-use, two-week and monthly contact lenses featuring advanced materials and optics to address vision challenges such as astigmatism, presbyopia and myopia with spherical, toric and multifocal lenses, and it also manufactures and markets myopia management products.

ConocoPhillips is an independent E&P company headquartered in Houston, Texas with operations and activities in 14 countries, whose diverse, low cost of supply portfolio includes resource-rich unconventional plays in North America, conventional assets in North America, Europe, Africa and Asia, LNG developments, oil sands in Canada, and an inventory of global exploration prospects. On December 31, 2025 it employed approximately 9,900 people worldwide and had total assets of about $122 billion, with total company production for the year of 2,375 MBOED. It was incorporated in the state of Delaware in 2001 in connection with and in anticipation of the merger between Conoco Inc. and Phillips Petroleum Company, which was consummated on August 30, 2002, and in April 2012 it completed the separation of the downstream business into an independent, publicly traded energy company, Phillips 66.

Cencora, Inc., a Delaware corporation, is one of the largest global pharmaceutical sourcing and distribution services companies, helping both healthcare providers and pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers improve patient access to products and enhance patient care. It delivers innovative programs and services designed to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of the pharmaceutical supply chain in both human and animal health, distributing a comprehensive offering of brand-name, specialty brand-name and generic pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter healthcare products, home healthcare supplies and equipment and related services to a wide variety of healthcare providers in the United States and select global markets, including acute care hospitals and health systems, independent and chain retail pharmacies, mail order pharmacies, medical clinics, long-term care and alternate site pharmacies, physician practices, medical and dialysis clinics and veterinarians. It serves its customers through a geographically diverse network of distribution service centers and other operations in the United States and select global markets, and in its pharmaceutical distribution businesses it is typically the primary supplier of pharmaceutical and related products to its healthcare provider customers.

Costco Wholesale Corporation operates membership warehouses and e-commerce sites based on the concept that offering low prices on a limited selection of nationally-branded and private-label products in a wide range of categories will produce high sales volumes and rapid inventory turnover. Combined with the operating efficiencies achieved by volume purchasing, efficient distribution and reduced handling of merchandise in no-frills, self-service warehouse facilities, these volumes and turnover enable it to operate profitably at significantly lower gross margins than most other retailers, and it often sells inventory before it is required to pay for it while taking advantage of early payment discounts. It reports on a 52/53-week fiscal year ending on the Sunday nearest the end of August, and its ancillary businesses include gas stations, food courts, pharmacies, optical and hearing services and tire installation.

Corpay, Inc. is a global corporate payments company that helps businesses and consumers better manage and pay their expenses in a simple, controlled manner, providing a broad suite of payment and spend management solutions including accounts payable automation and cross-border payment solutions such as foreign exchange spot, forward and option transactions, commercial card programs, vehicle payment solutions such as fuel cards and toll payments, and lodging payment solutions. Since its incorporation in 2000 it has delivered payment and spend solutions with customized controls and robust capabilities that offer its customers a better way to pay, saving them time and ultimately letting them spend less, and it has been a member of the S&P 500 since 2018 and trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CPAY.

Copart, Inc. is a leading global provider of online auctions and vehicle remarketing services, with operations in the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, Brazil, Canada, the United Arab Emirates, Spain, Finland, Oman, the Republic of Ireland and Bahrain.

Camden Property Trust, a Texas real estate investment trust formed on May 25, 1993, and its consolidated subsidiaries are primarily engaged in the ownership, management, development, reposition, redevelopment, acquisition and construction of multifamily apartment communities, which it refers to as communities, multifamily communities, properties or multifamily properties. It makes its annual, quarterly and current reports available free of charge through its website, and it views how it manages its human capital as critical to how it delivers on its strategy and creates sustained growth and value for its shareholders, seeking to differentiate itself by its culture and talent.

CRH public limited company is the leading provider of building materials critical to modernizing infrastructure, with a team of 83,032 people across 3,961 locations whose unmatched scale, connected portfolio and deep local relationships make it the partner of choice for transportation, water and reindustrialization projects. It holds market leadership positions in North America, Europe and Australia, has grown rapidly since its formation in 1970, and in 2025 generated $37.4 billion of total revenues, $3.8 billion of net income and $7.7 billion of adjusted EBITDA, with 40 percent of total revenues from infrastructure, 32 percent from residential construction and 28 percent from non-residential construction, and 60 percent of total revenues from sales to new-build construction and 40 percent from repair and remodel activity. Its connected portfolio supplies building materials across the construction value chain, and its Americas Division comprises two segments, Americas Materials Solutions and Americas Building Solutions.

Charles River Laboratories International, Inc. has three reportable segments: Research Models and Services, Discovery and Safety Assessment, and Manufacturing Solutions. Through its Research Models and Services segment it has provided foundational tools for the discovery of new molecules by supplying research models to the drug development industry since 1947, maintaining its position as a global leader in the production and sale of the most widely used research models, including over 140 different stocks and strains of purpose-bred rodents, and it also provides a variety of related services designed to support its clients, together with its Discovery and Safety Assessment services and its Manufacturing Solutions offering.

Salesforce, Inc. is a global leader in customer relationship management technology, helping organizations of any size become agentic enterprises, and founded in 1999 it brings humans, agents, applications and data together on a trusted, unified platform to unlock growth and innovation. Its artificial intelligence powered Agentforce 360 Platform unites its offerings spanning sales, service, marketing, commerce, collaboration, data management, integration, analytics, IT service and industry verticals on a single, intelligent platform for trusted enterprise execution, unifying and harmonizing across systems, applications and devices to create a complete view of customers, and with Agentforce, the agentic layer of the platform, customers can build, deploy and manage enterprise-grade, autonomous AI agents at scale, enabling humans and agents to work together, with agents able to access live business data through Data 360, follow company policies defined in Salesforce metadata, and take action through Salesforce applications and MuleSoft APIs.

Founded in 2011, CrowdStrike reinvented cybersecurity for the cloud and artificial intelligence era and transformed the way cybersecurity is delivered and experienced by customers. It took a fundamentally different approach with the AI-native CrowdStrike Falcon cybersecurity platform, which serves as the operating system for cybersecurity, building the first true cloud-native platform with AI at the core, capable of harnessing vast amounts of security and enterprise data to drive real-time security decisions and response stopping breaches at scale through a single lightweight sensor, and the platform is designed to be the definitive platform for cybersecurity consolidation, purpose-built to stop breaches.

Cisco designs and sells a broad range of technologies including hardware, software and artificial intelligence powered digital infrastructure to power, help secure and draw insights from the Internet. It is incorporating AI into its product portfolios across networking, security, collaboration and observability and integrating its products more tightly together into a platform, simplifying how its technology is delivered, managed and optimized and helping customers maximize the business value of their technology investments. It conducts its business globally and manages its business by geography through three geographic segments, Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific, Japan and China, with its products and technologies grouped into Networking, Security, Collaboration and Observability, plus a broad range of services over the product lifecycle including technical support and professional services.

CoStar Group, Inc. is a leading provider of online real estate marketplaces, information, analytics and 3D digital twin technology in the property markets, whose mission is to digitize the world's real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives. It owns and operates leading online marketplaces for real estate in the U.S., Australia, Europe, Canada and Asia-Pacific based on the numbers of unique visitors and site visits per month, provides more information, analytics and marketing services than many of its competitors, offers the most comprehensive commercial real estate database available, and has the largest commercial real estate research department in the industry.

CSX Corporation, based in Jacksonville, Florida, is one of the nation's leading transportation companies, providing rail-based freight transportation services including traditional rail service, the transport of intermodal containers and trailers, and other transportation services such as rail-to-truck transfers and bulk commodity operations. CSX and the rail industry provide customers with access to an expansive and interconnected transportation network that plays a key role in North American commerce and is critical to the long-term economic success and improved global competitiveness of the United States, and freight railroads provide the most economical and environmentally efficient means to transport goods over land. Its principal operating subsidiary, CSX Transportation, Inc., provides an important link to the transportation supply chain through its approximately 20,000 route-mile rail network serving major population centers in 26 states east of the Mississippi River.

Cintas Corporation, a Washington corporation, helps more than one million businesses of all types and sizes, primarily in the United States as well as Canada and Latin America, get ready to open their doors with confidence every day by providing a wide range of products and services that enhance customers' image and help keep their facilities and employees clean, safe and looking their best. Its products and services include uniforms, mats, mops, shop towels, restroom supplies, workplace water services, first aid and safety products, automated external defibrillators, eye-wash stations, safety training, fire extinguishers, sprinkler systems and alarm testing. Cintas was founded in 1968 by Richard T. Farmer when he left his family's industrial laundry business in order to develop uniform programs using an exclusive new fabric, and in the early 1970s it acquired the family industrial laundry business.

Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, engineering modern businesses and delivering strategic outcomes for its clients. It helps clients modernize technology, reimagine processes and transform experiences so they can stay ahead in a fast-changing world where artificial intelligence is reshaping organizations in every field, and as an AI builder it provides deep expertise at the intersection of industry and technology, combining its perspective with extensive knowledge of its clients' organizations to build industry-specific platforms and incorporate context into systems, AI models and custom solutions. It tailors its services and solutions to specific industries with an integrated global delivery model that employs client service and delivery teams based at client locations and dedicated global and regional delivery centers, and its services include consulting, application development, systems integration, quality engineering and assurance, application maintenance, infrastructure and security, and business process services and automation.

Corteva, Inc. is a leading global provider of seed and crop protection solutions focused on the agriculture industry and contributing to a healthier, more secure and sustainable food supply. Incorporated in Delaware in March 2018 with business headquarters in Indianapolis, Indiana, it has one of the broadest and most productive new product pipelines in the agriculture industry and is focused on progressing science-based innovations that aim to deliver a wide range of improved agriculture products and services to its customers, leveraging its rich heritage of scientific achievement to advance its robust innovation pipeline and shape the future of responsible agriculture. Its Seed segment offers seed and trait technologies that boost resilience to weather, pests, diseases and herbicides used to manage weeds, plus digital solutions that provide data-driven insights to help farmers optimize yield and profitability, with major brands including Pioneer, Brevant Seeds, Dairyland Seed, Hoegemeyer Hybrids, Nutech Seed, Seed Consultants, AgVenture, Pannar and PhytoGen cottonseed, and traits and technologies including ENLIST corn, ENLIST E3 soybeans and ENLIST cotton.

Carvana Co. is a holding company formed as a Delaware corporation in 2016 in order to operate the business of Carvana Group, LLC and its subsidiaries, whose Class A common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol CVNA. Carvana is the leading e-commerce platform for buying and selling used cars, transforming the used car buying and selling experience by giving consumers a wide selection, great value and quality, transparent pricing and a simple, no pressure transaction. Its differentiated business model combines a comprehensive online sales experience with a vertically integrated supply chain designed to sell high-quality vehicles to customers transparently and efficiently at a low price, serving a large and highly fragmented U.S. used auto retail market of approximately 37 million transactions in 2024 in which the top 10 used auto retailers accounted for less than 10 percent.

CVS Health Corporation is a leading health solutions company building a world of health around every consumer it serves and connecting care so that it works for people wherever they are. As of December 31, 2025 it had approximately 9,000 retail locations, more than 1,000 walk-in and primary care medical clinics and a leading pharmacy benefits manager with approximately 87 million plan members and expanding specialty pharmacy solutions, and it serves an estimated more than 37 million people through traditional, voluntary and consumer-directed health insurance products and related services, including expanding Medicare Advantage offerings and a leading standalone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan. It is creating new sources of value through its integrated model, allowing it to expand into personalized, technology-driven care delivery and health services, increasing access to quality care, delivering better health outcomes and lowering overall health care costs.

Chevron Corporation is a global energy company with direct and indirect subsidiaries and affiliates that conduct substantial business activities in countries including Angola, Argentina, Australia, Bangladesh, Brazil, Canada, China, Egypt, Equatorial Guinea, Guyana, Israel, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Nigeria, the Partitioned Zone between Saudi Arabia and Kuwait, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, the United Kingdom, the United States and Venezuela. Its objective is to safely deliver higher returns, lower carbon and superior shareholder value in any business environment, and its earnings depend mostly on the profitability of its upstream business segment, with the price of crude oil, which is determined in global markets outside of the company's control, the most significant factor affecting the results of operations for that segment.

Dominion Energy's portfolio of assets includes approximately 30.7 GW of electric generating capacity, 10,800 miles of electric transmission lines and 80,400 miles of electric distribution lines. It is one of the nation's leading developers and operators of regulated offshore wind and solar power and the largest producer of carbon-free electricity in New England, and its mission is to provide the reliable, affordable and increasingly clean energy that powers its customers every day. In connection with the comprehensive business review concluded in March 2024 it entered into agreements in September 2023 to sell all of its regulated gas distribution operations, except for a small company, to Enbridge, and it completed the sale in September 2023 of its remaining 50 percent noncontrolling partnership interest in Cove Point to BHE. It continues to focus on expanding and improving its regulated electric utilities and long-term contracted businesses while transitioning to a cleaner energy future, advancing an approximately $65 billion capital expenditure plan for 2026 through 2030.

Delta Air Lines, Inc. is a global airline based in the United States that connects customers across its expansive global network with a commitment to ensuring that the future of travel is connected, personalized and enjoyable, having served over 200 million customers in 2025 safely, reliably and with industry-leading customer service innovation. In its centennial year in 2025 it continued to differentiate itself from the industry and invest in extending its enduring competitive advantages, which support its trusted consumer brand and include its people and culture, operational reliability, global network, customer loyalty and financial foundation, with more than 100,000 employees providing world-class travel experiences, and it operates an award-winning SkyMiles loyalty program.

DoorDash, Inc.'s mission is to grow and empower local economies, which it pursues by providing services that reduce friction in local commerce and help merchants better connect with consumers in their communities, with primary offerings including the DoorDash Marketplace, the Wolt Marketplace, the Deliveroo Marketplace and its Commerce Platform. Its Marketplaces operate in over 40 countries, including the United States, and account for the vast majority of its revenue today, serving three primary constituents, merchants, consumers and Dashers, with an integrated suite of services that helps merchants establish an online presence, connect with consumers in their communities and solve mission-critical challenges such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing and customer support, and it typically earns a fee from merchants for the services it provides based on the size of each transaction.

DuPont de Nemours, Inc. is a leading provider of advanced solutions that improve everyday life across healthcare, water, construction and industrial markets, committed to helping customers advance their technology pipelines and provide solutions that address their unique challenges, from delivering clean water to enabling medical packaging solutions that enhance safety and performance. At December 31, 2025 it had subsidiaries in about 50 countries worldwide and manufacturing operations in about 20 countries. Its Healthcare & Water Technologies segment is a global leader in providing innovative high-performance products, components and solutions across a number of industries including medical packaging, medical devices, water filtration and purification, and protective garments, addressing challenges including an aging population and increasing complexity of high-performance medical devices, water scarcity, increasing regulatory requirements and the need for high-purity water.

Datadog, Inc. is the AI-powered observability and security platform for cloud applications. Its SaaS platform integrates and automates infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring, log management, user experience monitoring, cloud security, service management and many other capabilities to provide unified, real-time observability and security for its customers' entire technology stack. Datadog is used by organizations of all sizes and across a wide range of industries to enable digital transformation and cloud migration, drive collaboration among development, operations, security and business teams, accelerate time to market, reduce time to problem resolution, secure applications and infrastructure, understand user behavior and track key business metrics, and it has over 1,000 out-of-the-box integrations maintained by Datadog.

Deere & Company is a global leader in the production of agricultural, turf, construction and forestry equipment and solutions, and John Deere Financial provides financing for John Deere equipment, parts, services and other inputs customers need to run their operations. Its operations are managed through the Production & Precision Agriculture, Small Agriculture & Turf, Construction & Forestry, and Financial Services operating segments, and its Smart Industrial Operating Model aims to deliver greater value for customers, accelerate its competitive advantage in advanced technologies, build on its fundamental manufacturing strengths and core values, and capitalize on opportunities ahead by leveraging advanced technologies with its operational excellence, focused on three pillars: a strategic alignment of products and solutions around its customers' production systems; investments in technology and research and development delivering intelligent solutions through hardware and devices, embedded software, connectivity, data platforms and applications; and its go-to-market and distribution model.

Deckers Brands Corporation is a global leader in designing, marketing and distributing innovative footwear, apparel and accessories developed for both everyday casual lifestyle use and high-performance activities. It markets its products primarily under three proprietary brands, HOKA, UGG and Teva, which compete across the fashion and casual lifestyle, performance and outdoor categories, and it seeks to differentiate its brands and products by offering diverse lines that emphasize fashion, performance, authenticity, functionality, quality and comfort, with products tailored to a variety of activities, seasons and demographic groups, sold through quality domestic and international retailers and international distributors in its wholesale channel and directly to global consumers through its Direct-to-Consumer channel comprised of an ecommerce and retail store presence.

Dell Technologies Inc. is a leader in the global technology industry focused on providing broad and innovative technology solutions for the data and artificial intelligence era, ranging from client devices and peripherals to infrastructure solutions across servers, networking and storage to meet the evolving needs of its customers and drive better business outcomes. With its extensive portfolio and commitment to innovation it designs, deploys and supports secure, integrated solutions that extend from the edge to the core to the cloud, delivering AI-optimized, software-defined and cloud native infrastructure solutions across a broad partner ecosystem. It operates globally in over 170 countries, supported by a world-class organization across key functional areas including technology and product development, marketing, sales, services and financing, with a commercial portfolio addressing IT modernization and hybrid work transformation and a consumer portfolio ranging from essential computing and connectivity needs to high-end consumer and gaming offerings.

Dollar General Corporation is the largest discount retailer in the United States by number of stores, with 20,959 stores located in 48 U.S. states and Mexico as of February 27, 2026, with the greatest concentration of stores in the southern, southwestern, midwestern and eastern United States, and its first stores in Mexico opened in 2023. It offers a broad selection of merchandise, including consumable items, seasonal items, home products and apparel, including national brands from leading manufacturers as well as its own private brand selections with prices at substantial discounts to national brands, offered to customers at everyday low prices, typically $10 or less, in its convenient small-box locations, and its history began when J.L. Turner founded the company in 1939 as J.L. Turner and Son, Wholesale, incorporated as a Kentucky corporation under the name J.L. Turner & Son, Inc. in 1955 when it opened its first Dollar General store.

Quest Diagnostics works across the healthcare ecosystem to create a healthier world, one life at a time, providing diagnostic insights from the results of its laboratory testing to empower people, physicians and organizations to take action to improve health outcomes. Derived from one of the world's largest databases of de-identifiable clinical lab results, its diagnostic insights reveal new avenues to identify and treat disease, inspire healthy behaviors and improve healthcare management, and in the right hands and with the right context they can inspire actions that transform lives. The patients it serves annually comprise approximately one-third of the adult population of the United States, and over a three-year period it serves approximately one-half of the adult population of the United States, estimating that annually it serves approximately half of the physicians and half of the hospitals in the United States.

D.R. Horton, Inc. is the largest homebuilding company in the United States as measured by number of homes closed, and it constructs and sells homes through its operating divisions in 126 markets across 36 states. Its common stock is included in the S&P 500 Index and listed on the New York Stock Exchange and NYSE Texas under the ticker symbol DHI, with its listing on NYSE Texas becoming effective in June 2025. Its homebuilding business began in 1978 in Fort Worth, Texas, and its common stock has been publicly traded since 1992, and it has expanded and diversified its homebuilding operations geographically over the years by investing capital and building teams of people in its existing markets, starting new operations in additional markets and acquiring other homebuilding companies, having closed more than 1.2 million homes during its 47-year history.

Danaher Corporation is a global science and technology innovator committed to accelerating the power of science and technology to improve human health, comprised of more than 15 operating companies with leadership positions in the biotechnology, life sciences and diagnostics sectors, organized under three segments, Biotechnology, Life Sciences and Diagnostics, and united by the Danaher Business System, with businesses typically characterized by a high level of products and services sold on a recurring basis, primarily through a direct sales model and to a geographically diverse customer base, and with business research and development, manufacturing, sales, distribution, service and administrative facilities located in approximately 50 countries. It seeks to create shareholder value primarily by strengthening its competitive advantage through consistent application of Danaher Business System tools and culture, enhancing its portfolio in attractive science and technology markets through strategic capital allocation, and continuously improving its operational excellence.

The Walt Disney Company, together with the subsidiaries through which businesses are conducted, is a diversified worldwide entertainment company with operations in three segments: Entertainment, Sports and Experiences. The Entertainment segment generally encompasses the company's non-sports focused global film and episodic content production and distribution activities, with lines of business including Linear Networks, which include the ABC Television Network, Disney, Freeform, FX and National Geographic branded television channels and eight owned ABC television stations domestically, Disney, FX and National Geographic branded channels internationally, a 50 percent equity investment in A+E Global Media, and other related services; Direct-to-Consumer; and Content Sales and Licensing. Entertainment revenues include subscription fees, advertising, affiliate fees, theatrical distribution rentals from licensing its films to theaters, and licensing and other revenue.

Digital Realty Trust, Inc., through its controlling interest in Digital Realty Trust, L.P. and the subsidiaries of the Operating Partnership, is a leading global provider of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions for customers across a variety of industry verticals, with the Parent operating as a REIT for U.S. federal income tax purposes and the Operating Partnership being the entity through which the Parent conducts its business of owning, acquiring, developing and operating data centers. The Parent was incorporated in the state of Maryland on March 9, 2004, and the Operating Partnership was organized as a limited partnership in the state of Maryland on July 21, 2004. As of December 31, 2025 its portfolio included 310 data centers, including 89 data centers held as investments in unconsolidated entities, of which 118 are located in the United States, 113 in Europe, 36 in Latin America, 16 in Africa, 18 in Asia, six in Australia and three elsewhere, and its portfolio contained a total of approximately 57.6 million rentable square feet, including approximately 9.7 million square feet of space under active development and 4.7 million square feet of space held for development, and it is diversified across major metropolitan areas characterized by a high concentration of connected end-users and technology companies.

Dollar Tree, Inc. is a leading operator of retail discount stores operating under the brand names of Dollar Tree and Dollar Tree Canada, and at January 31, 2026 it operated approximately 9,000 stores across 48 states and the District of Columbia and approximately 275 stores across seven Canadian provinces. It believes the convenience and value it offers, as well as the thrill-of-the-hunt shopping experience where customers discover new celebratory and seasonal items every week, are key factors in serving and growing its base of loyal customers, and it continues to execute strategic initiatives to drive profitable growth as a standalone banner following the sale of Family Dollar, including an expanded and more relevant assortment, agile cost management, a more connected customer experience in stores, new store growth, and improved store conditions and operations supported by an evolving supply chain.

Healthpeak Properties, Inc. is a Standard & Poor's 500 company that owns, operates and develops high-quality real estate focused on healthcare discovery and delivery in the United States. Originally founded in 1985, it is organized as an umbrella partnership REIT and holds substantially all of its assets and conducts its operations through its operating subsidiary, Healthpeak OP, a consolidated subsidiary of which it is the managing member, and it is a Maryland corporation qualifying as a self-administered REIT headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It has a diversified portfolio of high-quality healthcare properties across three core asset classes of outpatient medical, lab and senior housing real estate, owning, operating and developing outpatient medical buildings, hospitals and lab buildings under the outpatient medical and lab segments.

Dover Corporation is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider delivering innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions and support services through five operating segments: Engineered Products, Clean Energy & Fueling, Imaging & Identification, Pumps & Process Solutions, and Climate & Sustainability Technologies. Incorporated in 1947 in the State of Delaware and a publicly traded company since 1955, it is headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois and currently employs approximately 24,000 people worldwide. Its five segments are structured around businesses with similar business models, go-to-market strategies, product categories and manufacturing practices, which increases management efficiency and better aligns its operations with its strategic initiatives and capital allocation.

Dow Inc. was incorporated on August 30, 2018 under Delaware law to serve as a holding company for The Dow Chemical Company and its consolidated subsidiaries, with Dow Inc. operating all of its businesses through TDCC, a wholly owned subsidiary incorporated in 1947 under Delaware law and the successor to a Michigan corporation of the same name organized in 1897, and the Company's principal executive offices are located at 2211 H.H. Dow Way, Midland, Michigan. Its Packaging and Specialty Plastics segment serves growing, high-value sectors using world-class technology, broad existing product lines and a rich product pipeline that creates competitive advantages for the entire packaging value chain, and is a recognized leader in the production, marketing and innovation of polyethylene and a leader in other ethylene derivatives such as polyolefin elastomers, ethylene vinyl acetate and ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber serving mobility, consumer, wire and cable, and construction end-markets.

Domino's Pizza, Inc. is the largest pizza company in the world with more than 22,100 locations in over 90 markets around the world as of December 28, 2025, operating two distinct service models within its stores with a significant business in both delivery and carryout. It is a highly recognized global brand focused on value while serving neighborhoods locally through its large worldwide network of franchise owners and U.S. company-owned stores, and it has been selling quality, affordable food since 1960, becoming Domino's Pizza in 1965 and opening its first franchised store in 1967, and over the past 65 years it has built Domino's into one of the most widely recognized consumer brands in the world. It is primarily a franchisor, with approximately 99 percent of its global stores owned and operated by independent franchisees as of December 28, 2025.

Darden Restaurants, Inc. is a full-service restaurant company that, as of May 31, 2026, owned and operated 2,202 restaurants through subsidiaries in the United States under the Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Yard House, Ruth's Chris Steak House, Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen, The Capital Grille, Chuy's, Seasons 52, Eddie V's Prime Seafood, Bahama Breeze and The Capital Burger trademarks, and it also had 167 restaurants operated by independent third parties pursuant to area development and franchise agreements, four restaurants operating under contractual agreements and one restaurant that it jointly owns with a third party and operates independently.

DTE Energy incorporated in Michigan in 1995, and its utility operations consist primarily of DTE Electric and DTE Gas, with two other segments engaged in a variety of energy-related businesses. DTE Electric, a Michigan corporation organized in 1903 and an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, is a public utility engaged in the generation, purchase, distribution and sale of electricity to approximately 2.3 million customers in southeastern Michigan. DTE Gas, a Michigan corporation organized in 1898 and an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, is a public utility engaged in the purchase, storage, transportation, distribution and sale of natural gas to approximately 1.4 million customers throughout Michigan and the sale of storage and transportation capacity. DTE Energy's other businesses include DTE Vantage, primarily involved in renewable natural gas projects and providing custom energy solutions to industrial, commercial and institutional customers, and Corporate and Other, which includes various holding company activities, certain non-utility debt and certain investments.

Duke Energy was incorporated on May 3, 2005 and is an energy company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, subject to regulation by FERC and other regulatory agencies, operating in the U.S. primarily through its direct and indirect subsidiaries. Certain subsidiaries are also Subsidiary Registrants, including Duke Energy Carolinas, Progress Energy, Duke Energy Progress, Duke Energy Florida, Duke Energy Ohio, Duke Energy Indiana and Piedmont, with operations in Kentucky conducted through Duke Energy Ohio's wholly owned subsidiary Duke Energy Kentucky. When discussing its consolidated financial information it necessarily includes the results of its separate Subsidiary Registrants, which along with Duke Energy are collectively referred to as the Duke Energy Registrants.

DaVita Inc. is a leading healthcare provider focused on transforming care delivery to improve quality of life for patients globally, and as a comprehensive kidney care provider it has been a leader in clinical quality and innovation for more than two decades. Its businesses include its U.S. dialysis operations, U.S. integrated kidney care, international operations and a few other ancillary services and investments outside those operations, collectively referred to as its ancillary services, along with a separate corporate administrative support function that supports the U.S. dialysis business and those ancillary services, and its patient-centric care model leverages its platform of kidney care.

Devon Energy Corporation is a leading independent energy company engaged primarily in the exploration, development and production of oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids, with its operations concentrated in various onshore areas in the U.S. It is also focused on water stewardship in support of its environmental objectives, continuing to advance its use of recycled water and targeting the use of 90 percent or more non-freshwater for completions activities in its most active operating areas within the Delaware Basin.

DexCom, Inc. is a medical device company primarily focused on the design, development and commercialization of continuous glucose monitoring, or CGM, systems for the management of diabetes and metabolic health by patients, caregivers and clinicians around the world. It received approval from the Food and Drug Administration and commercialized its first product in 2006, launched its latest generation Dexcom G7 Continuous Glucose Monitoring System in 2023 and the Dexcom G7 15 Day system in late 2025, and in August 2024 launched Stelo, its biosensor designed for adults with prediabetes and Type 2 diabetes who do not use insulin, as the first over-the-counter glucose biosensor in the U.S.

Founded in 1995 in San Jose, California, eBay Inc. is a global commerce leader that connects people and builds communities to create economic opportunity for all. Its technology empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world, and its Marketplace platforms, including its online marketplace and localized counterparts, its off-platform marketplaces and its suite of mobile apps, together create one of the world's largest and most vibrant marketplaces for discovering great value and a unique selection, enabling nearly $80 billion of Gross Merchandise Volume in 2025. As a global commerce leader and third-party marketplace, its technologies and services are designed to provide buyers choice and a breadth of relevant inventory.

EchoStar Corporation is a holding company that was organized in October 2007 as a corporation under the laws of the State of Nevada, whose Class A common stock is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol SATS, with principal executive offices located at 9601 South Meridian Boulevard, Englewood, Colorado. In the third quarter of 2025 it resolved the Federal Communications Commission's review into EchoStar's compliance with its build-out milestones and other obligations regarding its federal spectrum licenses, having previously received an FCC letter on May 9, 2025 indicating that the FCC was beginning a review of its compliance with certain obligations to provide 5G broadband service.

Ecolab was incorporated as a Delaware corporation in 1924, and describes itself as a trusted partner for millions of customers and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. For more than a century it has advanced innovation by integrating science-based solutions, data-driven insights, AI technology and world-class service, which enables it to partner with customers to define what best-in-class looks like and scale it across their operations, helping them achieve peak performance. Today it has $16 billion in annual sales and 48,000 associates, and its Paper segment provides water and process applications for the pulp and paper industry, offering a comprehensive portfolio of programs used in all principal steps of the papermaking process and across all grades of paper.

Consolidated Edison, Inc., incorporated in New York State in 1997, is a holding company that owns all of the outstanding common stock of Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc., Orange and Rockland Utilities, Inc. and Con Edison Transmission, Inc. Its principal business operations are those of CECONY, whose principal business operations are its regulated electric, gas and steam delivery businesses; Orange and Rockland Utilities, whose principal business operations are its regulated electric and gas delivery businesses; and Con Edison Transmission, which through its subsidiaries develops and invests in electric transmission projects and owns, through joint ventures, both electric and gas assets. Con Edison seeks to provide shareholder value through continued dividend growth, supported by earnings growth.

Equifax Inc. is a global data, analytics and technology company that provides information solutions for businesses, governments and consumers, and human resources business process automation and outsourcing services for employers, serving a large and diversified group of clients including financial institutions, corporations, government agencies and individuals. Its services are based on comprehensive databases of consumer and business information derived from numerous sources including credit, financial assets, telecommunications and utility payments, employment, income, educational history, criminal justice, healthcare professional licensure and sanctions, demographic and marketing data, and it uses advanced statistical techniques, artificial intelligence and machine learning, as well as proprietary software tools to analyze available data for the creation of customized insights, decision-making and process automation solutions and processing services. It is a leading provider of information and solutions used in payroll-related and other employment-related transactions.

Everest Group, Ltd. is a Bermuda-based reinsurance and insurance organization and, as part of the S&P 500 Index, a leading financial services institution focused on diversifying its portfolio and geographic presence. Through its direct and indirect subsidiaries operating in the U.S. and internationally it serves a diverse group of clients worldwide, providing extensive product and distribution capabilities, a strong balance sheet, an innovative culture and access to world-class talent. At December 31, 2025 it had shareholders' equity of $15.5 billion and total assets of $62.5 billion. Its principal business, conducted through its Reinsurance and Insurance reportable segments, is the underwriting of reinsurance and insurance in the U.S., Bermuda and other international markets, with a global network spanning more than 100 countries across six continents, and in 2025 it had gross written premiums of $17.7 billion, approximately 72.4 percent representing Reinsurance and 27.1 percent representing Insurance.

Edison International was incorporated in 1987 as the parent holding company of Southern California Edison Company, a California public utility incorporated in 1909, and it also owns Trio, a global energy advisory firm providing integrated sustainability and energy solutions to commercial, industrial and institutional customers. Its principal executive office is located at 2244 Walnut Grove Avenue in Rosemead, California, and it files a combined Annual Report on Form 10-K with Southern California Edison Company.

The Estée Lauder Companies Inc., founded in 1946 by Estée and Joseph Lauder, is one of the world's leading manufacturers, marketers and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products, and a steward of over 20 luxury and prestige brands globally. Since the initial launch of the Estée Lauder brand in the United States it has significantly expanded its consumer reach to approximately 150 countries and territories. It operates as a wholesaler, with products sold in brick-and-mortar locations and on various e-commerce platforms including those operated by department stores, duty-free retailers, specialty-multi retailers, online pure players, upscale perfumeries and pharmacies, and top-tier salons and spas, and additionally operates a direct-to-consumer business across freestanding stores, its brands' websites and third-party online platforms. In February 2025 it embarked on Beauty Reimagined, a strategic vision focused on accelerating best-in-class consumer coverage, creating transformative innovation and boosting consumer-facing investment.

Elevance Health, Inc. and its direct and indirect subsidiaries constitute a leading health company bringing together the concepts of elevate and advance, focused on enhancing well-being and advancing health outcomes by delivering integrated, whole health solutions across the care journey. It supports consumers throughout their full health journeys with medical, pharmacy and behavioral health services designed to address their whole health needs, and through this comprehensive approach aims to improve the health of the people and communities it serves, advancing its mission by collaborating with care providers and community organizations, fostering innovation that supports growth and equal opportunity for health access, and cultivating a high-performance culture. It is one of the largest health insurers in the United States in terms of medical membership and reports results in four reportable segments, Health Benefits, CarelonRx, Carelon Services and Corporate & Other.

EMCOR Group, Inc. is one of the largest specialty contractors in the United States and a leading provider of electrical and mechanical construction and facilities services, building services, and industrial services, with revenues of $16.99 billion in 2025. Its services are provided to a broad range of commercial, technology, manufacturing, industrial, healthcare, utility and institutional customers through approximately 100 operating subsidiaries, which specialize principally in providing construction services relating to electrical and mechanical systems in all types of facilities and in providing various services relating to the operation, maintenance and management of those facilities, and such operating subsidiaries are organized into reportable segments for United States electrical construction and facilities services, United States mechanical construction and facilities services, United States building services, and United States industrial services.

Emerson Electric Co. is a global technology and software company that provides innovative solutions for customers in a wide range of end markets around the world, and through its leading automation portfolio it helps process, hybrid and discrete manufacturers optimize operations, protect personnel, reduce emissions and achieve their sustainability goals, with sales by geographic destination in 2025 of the Americas at 51 percent, Asia, Middle East and Africa at 30 percent including China at 10 percent, and Europe at 19 percent. Portfolio management is an integral component of its growth and value creation strategy, and over the past three years it has taken significant actions to accelerate the transformation of its portfolio through the completion of strategic acquisitions and divestitures of non-core businesses, creating a cohesive, higher growth, higher margin industrial technology portfolio and making it a global automation leader serving a diversified set of end markets. It was incorporated in Missouri in 1890.

EOG Resources, Inc., a Delaware corporation organized in 1985, together with its subsidiaries explores for, develops, produces and markets crude oil, natural gas liquids and natural gas primarily in major producing basins in the United States, the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago and, from time to time, select other international areas, including the Kingdom of Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates.

Equinix, Inc. is the world's digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to boundless connectivity anywhere in the world to enable the innovations that enrich work, life and planet. It combines a global footprint of International Business Exchange and xScale data centers in the Americas, Asia-Pacific, and Europe, the Middle East and Africa regions, infrastructure and interconnection offerings, and digital ecosystems required to serve a large and diverse set of customers around the world. Incorporated on June 22, 1998 as a Delaware corporation and operating as a REIT for federal income tax purposes, it has been a network-neutral, multi-tenant data center provider since its inception, where competing networks could connect and share data traffic.

EQT Corporation is a vertically integrated natural gas company with upstream, gathering and transmission operations focused in the Appalachian Basin, and as of December 31, 2025 it had 28.0 Tcfe of proved natural gas, NGLs and oil reserves across approximately 2.3 million gross acres and approximately 2,945 miles of pipeline infrastructure, plus an investment in Series A of Mountain Valley Pipeline, LLC, which owns the 303-mile-long Mountain Valley Pipeline spanning from Wetzel County, West Virginia to Pittsylvania County, Virginia. Its core business strategy is to be the leading low-cost producer of natural gas with a business model designed to generate durable free cash flow across commodity price cycles, relying on its substantial inventory of core drilling locations, its vast midstream infrastructure spanning the Appalachian Basin, its investment grade credit metrics, the low emissions profile of its operations and its best-in-class team and culture.

Erie Indemnity Company is a publicly held Pennsylvania business corporation that has since its incorporation in 1925 served as the attorney-in-fact for the subscribers, or policyholders, at the Erie Insurance Exchange, a Pennsylvania-domiciled reciprocal insurer that writes property and casualty insurance and also commenced business in 1925. The Exchange has wholly owned property and casualty insurance subsidiaries including Erie Insurance Company, Erie Insurance Company of New York, Erie Insurance Property & Casualty Company and Flagship City Insurance Company, and a wholly owned life insurance company, Erie Family Life Insurance Company. Its primary function as attorney-in-fact is to perform policy issuance and renewal services on behalf of the subscribers at the Exchange, and it also acts as attorney-in-fact with respect to all claims handling and investment management services, as well as the service provider for all claims handling and life insurance functions.

Eversource Energy, headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts and Hartford, Connecticut, is a public utility holding company subject to regulation by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission under the Public Utility Holding Company Act of 2005, engaged primarily in the energy delivery business through its wholly-owned utility subsidiaries: The Connecticut Light and Power Company, a regulated electric utility serving residential, commercial and industrial customers in parts of Connecticut; NSTAR Electric Company, a regulated electric utility serving residential, commercial and industrial customers in parts of eastern and western Massachusetts that owns solar power facilities, and its wholly-owned subsidiary Harbor Electric Energy Company; Public Service Company of New Hampshire; and other subsidiaries.

Essex Property Trust, Inc., a Maryland corporation and an S&P 500 company, operates as a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust, owning all of its interest in its real estate and other investments directly or indirectly through Essex Portfolio, L.P., of which it is the sole general partner with an approximately 96.6 percent general partner interest as of December 31, 2025. It has elected to be treated as a REIT for federal income tax purposes commencing with the year ended December 31, 1994 and completed its initial public offering on June 13, 1994, and to maintain compliance with REIT tax rules it utilizes taxable REIT subsidiaries for various revenue generating or investment activities. The company focuses on acquiring and developing apartment communities in supply constrained markets, and redeveloping its existing communities to improve the financial and physical aspects of its communities.

Eaton Corporation plc is an intelligent power management company dedicated to protecting the environment and improving the quality of life for people everywhere. It makes products for the data center, utility, industrial, commercial, machine building, residential, aerospace and mobility markets, and is capitalizing on the megatrends of electrification, digitalization, and the reindustrialization of and growth of megaprojects in North America and increased global infrastructure spending, which are expanding its end markets and positioning it for growth. It is strengthening its participation across the entire electrical power value chain and benefiting from momentum in the data center and utility end markets as well as a growth cycle in the commercial aerospace and defense markets, and is guided by its commitment to operate sustainably and with the highest ethical standards.

Entergy is an integrated energy company engaged primarily in electric power production and energy delivery to retail customers. It owns and operates power plants with approximately 25,000 MW of electric generating capacity, delivers electricity to approximately 3.1 million Utility customers in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas, had annual revenues of $12.9 billion in 2025 and had approximately 12,000 employees as of December 31, 2025. Its strategy is to operate and grow its utility business designed to understand and meet customer needs, creating value for all of its key stakeholders, including customers, communities, employees and owners, and it invests significant capital to support customer growth as well as reliability and resilience and is also investing in clean energy.

Evergy, Inc., Evergy Kansas Central, Inc. and Evergy Metro, Inc. are separate registrants that file a combined annual report on Form 10-K as individual registrants within the Evergy consolidated group, and Evergy, Inc. is a public utility holding company whose electric customer base consists of approximately 37 percent residential, 33 percent commercial, 11 percent industrial and 5 percent wholesale customers.

Edwards Lifesciences Corporation is the leading global structural heart innovation company, driven by a passion to improve patient lives, and through breakthrough technologies, world-class evidence and meaningful partnerships with clinicians and healthcare stakeholders its employees are inspired by its patient-focused culture to deliver life-changing innovations. It has been a leader in its field for over six decades, and since its founder, Miles Lowell Edwards, first dreamed of using engineering to address diseases of the human heart it has steadily built a company on the premise of imagining, building and realizing a better future for patients. Its innovative work encompasses both surgical and transcatheter therapies, and its unique portfolio of repair and replacement technologies for aortic, mitral, tricuspid and pulmonic heart valves provides a broad set of treatment options, with transcatheter aortic heart valves first commercialized in Europe in 2007, in the United States in 2011 and in Japan in 2013.

Exelon Corporation is a utility services holding company engaged in the energy transmission and distribution businesses through its subsidiaries, ComEd, PECO, BGE, Pepco, DPL and ACE, which purchase and sell electricity and natural gas and transmit and distribute electricity and natural gas to retail customers across northern Illinois including the City of Chicago, southeastern Pennsylvania including the City of Philadelphia, central Maryland including the City of Baltimore, portions of Delaware and Maryland, the District of Columbia and major portions of Montgomery and Prince George's Counties, Maryland, and portions of southern New Jersey.

Expand Energy Corporation, with principal executive offices in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, is the largest independent natural gas producer in the U.S. based on net daily production, and is focused on responsibly developing an abundant supply of natural gas, oil and NGL to expand energy access for all. Its operations are located in Louisiana and Texas in the Haynesville and Bossier Shales, in Pennsylvania in the Marcellus Shale, and in West Virginia and Ohio in the Marcellus and Utica Shales, and include working interests in approximately 6,600 gross natural gas and oil wells. On October 1, 2024 it completed the Southwestern Merger, creating a premier energy company that it believes is underpinned by a leading natural gas portfolio.

Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. provides a full suite of global logistics services, offering customers access to an international network of people and integrated information systems to support the movement and strategic positioning of goods. As a third-party logistics provider it purchases cargo space from carriers such as airlines, ocean shipping lines and trucking lines on a volume basis and resells that space to its customers, and it does not compete for overnight courier or small parcel business and does not own aircraft or ships. It provides a broad range of transportation services and customer solutions such as customs brokerage, order management, time-definite transportation, warehousing and distribution, temperature-controlled transit, cargo insurance, specialized cargo monitoring and tracking, and other customized logistics and consulting solutions, and its Project Cargo unit handles special project shipments that move via a single method or combination of air, ocean and ground transportation.

Expedia Group is the global travel marketplace with one purpose: to help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. It connects travelers, partners and advertisers throughout its trusted brands, leading technology and rich first-party data, delivering predictive, personalized experiences that shape the future of travel, and it makes available, on a stand-alone and package basis, travel services provided by numerous lodging properties, airlines, car rental companies, activities and experiences providers, cruise lines, alternative accommodations property owners and managers, and other travel product and service companies. It also offers travel and non-travel advertisers access to a potential source of incremental traffic and transactions through its various media and advertising offerings on its websites and apps, and it is one of the world's largest online travel companies, yet its gross bookings represent a single-digit percentage of total worldwide travel spending, highlighting the size of its market opportunity.

Extra Space Storage Inc. is a fully integrated, self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust formed as a Maryland corporation on April 30, 2004, which closed its initial public offering on August 17, 2004 and whose common stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol EXR. It was formed to continue the business of Extra Space Storage LLC and its subsidiaries, which had engaged in the self-storage business since 1977, and these companies were reorganized after the consummation of its IPO and various formation transactions. Substantially all of its business is conducted through Extra Space Storage LP, the Operating Partnership, in which its primary assets are general partner and limited partner interests, a structure commonly referred to as an umbrella partnership REIT, or UPREIT, and it has elected to be taxed as a REIT. Its acquisitions team continues to pursue the acquisition of multi-store portfolios and single stores which can range from fully occupied to various stages of lease-up.

Ford Motor Company was incorporated in Delaware in 1919, having acquired the business of a Michigan company incorporated in 1903 to produce and sell automobiles designed and engineered by Henry Ford, and is a global company based in Dearborn, Michigan with about 169,000 employees worldwide, committed to helping build a better world where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams. Its Ford+ plan for growth and value creation combines existing strengths, new capabilities and always-on relationships with customers to enrich experiences and deepen their loyalty, and it develops and delivers innovative, must-have Ford trucks, sport utility vehicles, commercial vans and cars and Lincoln luxury vehicles, along with connected services including BlueCruise driver assistance and security, offering freedom of choice through three customer-centered business segments: Ford Blue, engineering iconic gas-powered and hybrid vehicles; Ford Model e, inventing breakthrough electric vehicles; and Ford Pro, selling and servicing vehicles, parts and services to commercial, government and rental customers.

Diamondback Energy, Inc. is an independent oil and natural gas company focused on the acquisition, development, exploration and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil and natural gas reserves primarily in the Permian Basin in West Texas, a basin characterized by an extensive production history, a favorable operating environment, mature infrastructure, long reserve life, multiple producing horizons, enhanced recovery potential and a large number of operators, and it reports operations in one reportable segment, the upstream segment. Its activities are primarily focused on horizontal development of the Spraberry and Wolfcamp formations of the Midland Basin and the Wolfcamp and Bone Spring formations of the Delaware Basin, both of which are part of the larger Permian Basin in West Texas and New Mexico.

Fastenal began as a partnership in 1967 and was incorporated under the laws of Minnesota in 1968, opening its first branch in 1967 in Winona, Minnesota. It began with a marketing strategy of supplying threaded fasteners to customers through a branch network in small, medium and, in subsequent years, large cities, and over time how and where it engages customers has expanded and evolved. Today it sells a broader range of industrial and construction supplies spanning more than nine major product lines through a global network of locations utilizing diverse technologies such as vending devices, bin stock devices and eBusiness, with the large majority of its transactions being business-to-business, and at the end of 2025 it had 1,595 branch locations in 25 countries.

Freeport-McMoRan Inc. is a leading international metals company with the objective of being foremost in copper. Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, it operates large, long-lived, geographically diverse assets with significant proven and probable mineral reserves of copper, gold and molybdenum, and is one of the world's largest publicly traded copper producers. Its portfolio of assets includes the Grasberg minerals district in Indonesia, one of the world's largest copper and gold deposits, and significant operations in the U.S. and South America, including the large-scale Morenci minerals district in Arizona and the Cerro Verde operation in Peru.

FactSet Research Systems Inc. and its wholly-owned subsidiaries was founded in 1978 and has been publicly traded since June 1996, and is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the NASDAQ Stock Market under the symbol FDS and has been a member of the S&P 500 since December 2021.
