On July 2, 2015, through a series of transactions, it consummated the merger of Kraft Foods Group, Inc. with and into a wholly-owned subsidiary of H.J. Heinz Holding Corporation, at the closing of which Heinz was renamed The Kraft Heinz Company and H. J. Heinz Company changed its name to Kraft Heinz Foods Company, and on September 2, 2025 it announced its intention to separate the company into two independent publicly traded companies.

Kimco Realty Operation LLC is the leading owner and operator of high-quality, open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use properties in the United States, with its executive officers engaged in the day-to-day management and operation of real estate exclusively with the company, with nearly all operating functions including leasing, asset management, maintenance, construction, legal, finance and accounting administered by the company, and its mission is to create destinations for everyday living that inspire a sense of community and deliver value to its many stakeholders. It began operations through its predecessor, The Kimco Corporation, which was organized in 1966 upon the contribution of several shopping center properties owned by its principal stockholders; in 1973 these principals formed the company as a Delaware corporation, in 1985 the operations of The Kimco Corporation were merged into the company, and it completed its initial public stock offering in November 1991. Its primary business objective is to be the premier owner and operator of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use assets in the U.S.

KKR & Co. Inc. is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions, aiming to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. Founded in 1976, KKR pioneered the leveraged buyout strategy and has been a leader of the private equity industry for five decades, and since its inception it has expanded its investment strategies and product offerings from traditional private equity to other alternative asset classes such as leveraged credit, alternative credit, infrastructure, real estate, energy, growth equity and core private equity, scaling from a U.S.-focused firm to a global operation with 36 offices around the world as of December 31, 2025, and its business further expanded with the 2021 acquisition of Global Atlantic, which today conducts its insurance business providing retirement and life insurance solutions.

KLA Corporation and its majority-owned subsidiaries are suppliers of industry-leading equipment and services that enable innovation throughout the electronics industry, providing advanced process control and process-enabling solutions for manufacturing wafers, reticles and masks, chemicals and materials, integrated circuits, packaged integrated circuits and printed circuit boards, as well as comprehensive support and services across its installed base. Its suite of advanced products, coupled with its unique process control software and services, allows it to deliver solutions that help customers achieve their technology advancement and high-volume production goals by improving yields while reducing waste, risks and costs, improving customers' overall profitability and return on investment, and its services business accounted for approximately 23 percent of total revenues in fiscal 2026.

Kimberly-Clark Corporation, founded in 1872 and incorporated in Delaware in 1928, is a global company focused on delivering essential products and solutions that solve unmet consumer needs and provide Better Care for a Better World, and is principally engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of a wide range of products made from natural or synthetic fibers and materials using advanced technologies in fibers, nonwovens and absorbency. Kimberly-Clark and its trusted brands are an indispensable part of life for people in more than 175 countries and territories, and its portfolio of brands, including Huggies, Kleenex, Scott, Kotex, Cottonelle, Poise, Depend, Andrex, Pull-Ups, GoodNites, Intimus, Plenitud, Sweety, Softex, Viva and WypAll, holds No. 1 or No. 2 share positions in approximately 70 countries and encompasses five global daily-need product categories: Baby & Child Care, Adult Care, Feminine Care, Family Care, and Professional. Its largest customer, Walmart Inc., represented approximately 16 percent of net sales in 2025 and 2024.

Kinder Morgan, Inc. is one of the largest energy infrastructure companies in North America, and as of December 31, 2025 it owned an interest in or operated approximately 78,000 miles of pipelines, 136 terminals, approximately 706 Bcf of working natural gas storage capacity, and RNG generation capacity of approximately 6.9 Bcf per year of gross production. Its pipelines transport natural gas, refined petroleum products, crude oil, condensate, CO2, renewable fuels and other products, and its terminals store and handle various commodities including gasoline, diesel fuel, jet fuel, chemicals, petroleum coke, metals, and ethanol and other renewable fuels and feedstocks.

The Coca-Cola Company is a total beverage company, whose beverage products bearing its trademarks, sold in the United States since 1886, are now sold in more than 200 countries and territories. It owns or licenses and markets numerous beverage brands, which it groups into the categories of Trademark Coca-Cola, sparkling flavors, water, sports, coffee and tea, juice, value-added dairy and plant-based beverages, and emerging beverages, and it owns and markets several of the world's largest nonalcoholic sparkling soft drink brands, including Coca-Cola, Sprite, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, Fanta and Diet Coke/Coca-Cola Light. It makes its branded beverage products available to consumers throughout the world through its network of independent bottling partners, distributors, wholesalers and retailers as well as its consolidated bottling and distribution operations.

The Kroger Co. was founded in 1883 and incorporated in 1902, and its company is built on the foundation of its retail grocery business, which includes the added convenience of its retail pharmacies and fuel centers, with a strategy focused on growing households and increasing customer loyalty by delivering great value and convenience and investing in Fresh, Our Brands, Personalization and eCommerce. It utilizes the data and traffic generated by its retail business to create personalized experiences and value for its customers, and that data and traffic also enable its fast-growing, high operating margin alternative profit business, including third-party media revenue, and in turn the value generated from these businesses enables it to reinvest back into its retail business. Revenues are predominately earned and cash is generated as consumer products are sold to customers in its stores and fuel centers and via its online platforms, and its Our Brands play an important role in its merchandising strategy, representing over $39 billion of sales in 2025, with its supermarkets on average stocking over 13,000 private label items.

Kenvue Inc.'s purpose is to realize the extraordinary power of everyday care, and as a global leader at the intersection of healthcare and consumer goods it is the world's largest pure-play consumer health company by revenue, with $15.1 billion in net sales in the fiscal year 2025, combining the power of science with meaningful consumer insights and a digital strategy to empower consumers to live healthier lives. Built on more than a century of heritage and trusted by generations, its differentiated portfolio of iconic brands including Aveeno, BAND-AID Brand, Johnson's, Listerine, Neutrogena, Nicorette, Tylenol and Zyrtec is backed by science and recommended by healthcare professionals. Its portfolio includes Self Care, Skin Health and Beauty, and Essential Health products, connecting with consumers across North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Latin America, and it reports those three business segments.

Loews Corporation was incorporated in 1969 and is a holding company whose subsidiaries are engaged in the following lines of business: commercial property and casualty insurance through CNA Financial Corporation, an approximately 92 percent owned subsidiary; transportation and storage of natural gas and natural gas liquids, olefins and other hydrocarbons through Boardwalk Pipeline Partners, LP, a wholly owned subsidiary; and operation of a chain of hotels through Loews Hotels Holding Corporation, a wholly owned subsidiary. It also owns approximately 53 percent of Altium Packaging LLC, an unconsolidated subsidiary engaged in the manufacture of rigid plastic packaging solutions, and it has four reportable segments comprised of three individual consolidated operating subsidiaries, CNA Financial Corporation, Boardwalk Pipeline Partners, LP and Loews Hotels Holding Corporation, and the Corporate segment.

Leidos Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation, is a holding company whose direct 100 percent owned subsidiary and principal operating company is Leidos, Inc., which was founded in 1969 by physicist Dr. Robert Beyster and has since applied its expertise in science, research and engineering in rapidly evolving technologies and markets to solve complex problems of global concern. Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations, and is headquartered in Reston, Virginia with 47,000 global employees, pursuing strategic growth across five pillars: space and maritime, energy infrastructure, digital modernization and cyber, mission software, and managed health services, with customers including the U.S. Department of War, the U.S. Intelligence Community and other U.S. government agencies as well as commercial customers.

Lennar Corporation is one of the largest homebuilders in the United States by deliveries, revenues and net earnings, an originator of residential and commercial mortgage loans, a provider of title insurance and closing services and a developer of multifamily rental properties. In addition it is a sponsor and manager of funds and joint ventures engaged in development and ownership of multifamily rental properties and a sponsor and manager of a fund engaged in ownership of single-family rental properties, and it also has investments in companies that are engaged in applying technology to improve the homebuilding industry and real estate related aspects of the financial services industry. Its homebuilding operations are the most substantial part of its business, generating $32 billion in revenues, or approximately 94 percent of consolidated revenues, in fiscal 2025, and it operates primarily under the Lennar brand name with its homebuilding mission focused on the profitable development of residential communities, selling homes in communities targeted to first-time, move-up, active adult and luxury homebuyers, with an average sales price of a Lennar home of $391,000 for fiscal 2025 excluding deliveries from unconsolidated entities, compared to $423,000 in fiscal 2024 and $445,000 in fiscal 2023.

Labcorp Holdings Inc. is a global leader of innovative and comprehensive laboratory services that provides vital information to help doctors, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, researchers and patients make clear and confident decisions, providing insights and accelerating innovations to improve health and improve lives through its unparalleled diagnostics and drug development laboratory capabilities. During 2025 its nearly 71,000 employees served clients in approximately 100 countries and performed more than 750 million tests for patients around the world, and the company provided support for more than 85 percent of the new drugs and therapeutic products approved in 2025 by the FDA. It focuses on four primary specialty testing areas that it believes represent significant growth areas: oncology, women's health, autoimmune disease, and neurology.

L3Harris Technologies, Inc. describes itself as the Trusted Disruptor in the defense industry, and with customers' mission-critical needs in mind it delivers end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security. It supports customers in more than 100 countries, with its largest customers being various departments and agencies of the U.S. Government, their prime contractors and international allies, and its capabilities have defense and civil government applications as well as commercial applications. Its fiscal year ends on the Friday nearest December 31, and it structures its operations into segments including Integrated Mission Systems, covering airborne passive sensing and targeting, mission systems development, integration and life-cycle management for strategic reconnaissance and air superiority platforms, national command and control, tactical surveillance, electronic attack, agile strike, mobility and classified platforms; Maritime, providing power, electrical, imaging, communication and sensor systems for naval platforms, integrated autonomous vessels for surface and undersea operations, fleet management, in-service support, missionization prototyping and naval integration; and Communications, covering the space, tactical communications and networked systems.

Lennox International Inc. is a global leader in energy-efficient climate-control solutions, designing, manufacturing and marketing a broad range of products for the heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration markets, and it has leveraged its expertise to become an industry leader known for innovation, quality and reliability, with its products and services sold through multiple distribution channels under various brand names. The company was founded in 1895 in Marshalltown, Iowa by Dave Lennox, the owner of a machine repair business for railroads, who designed and patented a riveted steel coal-fired furnace, which led to numerous advancements in heating, cooling and climate control solutions, and it operates two business segments, Home Comfort Solutions and Building Climate Solutions.

Linde plc is a public limited company formed under the laws of Ireland with its principal offices in the United Kingdom and United States, and it is the largest industrial gas company worldwide and a major technological innovator in the industrial gases industry. Its primary products in its industrial gases business are atmospheric gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, argon and rare gases, and process gases, including hydrogen, helium, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, electronic gases, specialty gases and acetylene. It also designs and builds equipment that produces industrial gases and offers customers a wide range of gas production and processing services such as olefin plants, natural gas plants, air separation plants, hydrogen and synthesis gas plants, and other types of plants, serving a diverse group of industries including healthcare, chemicals and energy, manufacturing, metals and mining, food and beverage, and electronics, with sales of $33,986 million in 2025 and approximately 64 percent of its 2025 sales outside of the United States.

Lumentum Holdings Inc. is a global leader in optical and photonic technologies and an industry-leading provider of optical and photonic products based on revenue and market share, whose products are essential to a range of cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning, telecommunications, consumer and industrial end-market applications. It operates in one reportable segment as a single, integrated enterprise, and disaggregates revenue by type of product, Components and Systems, and by geography, where a Components product is one of the individual building blocks that go into creating a larger solution, typically not a complete solution on its own but a specialized element that enables system functionality, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems and wavelength management systems.

Eli Lilly and Company, incorporated in 1901 in Indiana to succeed to the drug manufacturing business founded in Indianapolis in 1876 by Colonel Eli Lilly, discovers, develops, manufactures and markets human pharmaceutical products in a single business segment, with a purpose to unite caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. It manufactures and distributes its products through facilities in the United States, including Puerto Rico, and in Europe and Asia, and its products are sold in approximately 90 countries. Its long-term success depends on its ability to continually discover or acquire, develop and commercialize innovative medicines, with a portfolio that includes cardiometabolic health products such as Basaglar, Humalog and Trulicity, and obesity and sleep apnea treatments including Zepbound.

Lockheed Martin Corporation is a global aerospace and defense technology company that builds and sustains the solutions America and its allies need to deter conflict and advance national security and scientific exploration objectives, with its four business areas Aeronautics, Missiles and Fire Control, Rotary and Mission Systems, and Space working as one company offering integrated solutions, at scale, across all warfighting domains, and its defense, space, intelligence, homeland security, information technology and cybersecurity capabilities serving U.S. and international customers in defense, civil and commercial applications, with its principal customers being agencies of the U.S. Government and allies. It is rapidly transforming its business to meet increased demand, expanding production capacity to continue delivering at scale and harnessing leading-edge technologies like artificial intelligence and autonomy.

Alliant Energy maintains its principal executive offices in Madison, Wisconsin, and operates as a regulated investor-owned public utility holding company whose purpose-driven strategy is to serve its customers and build stronger communities. Its primary focus is providing regulated electric and natural gas service to approximately 1,010,000 electric and approximately 435,000 natural gas customers in the Midwest through two public utility subsidiaries, IPL and WPL. IPL is engaged principally in the generation and distribution of electricity and the distribution and transportation of natural gas to retail customers in select markets in Iowa, serving approximately 505,000 electric and 230,000 natural gas retail customers at December 31, 2025.

Lowe's Companies, Inc. and its subsidiaries, a Fortune 100 company, is the world's second largest home improvement retailer, and as of January 30, 2026 it operated 1,759 home improvement stores and outlets in the United States, representing approximately 196 million square feet of retail selling space, and in addition operated over 540 branch locations in the United States and Canada, which include its current year acquisitions of Foundation Building Materials and Artisan Design Group. Lowe's was founded in 1921 with the opening of its first hardware store in North Wilkesboro, North Carolina, was incorporated in North Carolina in 1952 and has been publicly held since 1961, and its common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol LOW. It operates as an omnichannel retailer focused on serving individual homeowners and renters completing a wide array of projects along the spectrum of DIY and do-it-for-me, as well as small to medium sized Pro customers including tradespeople, repair and remodelers and property managers.

Incorporated in 1980, Lam Research Corporation is a Delaware corporation headquartered in Fremont, California, that maintains a network of facilities throughout Asia, Europe and the United States in order to meet the needs of its dynamic customer base. Its product portfolio spans deposition, including electrochemical deposition of copper and other metal films with its SABRE family, chemical vapor deposition and atomic layer deposition of tungsten and molybdenum with its ALTUS family, and dielectric films, together with related etch and clean technologies for wafer fabrication, and it provides the equipment and services used by semiconductor manufacturers to produce advanced devices.

lululemon athletica inc. is principally a designer, distributor and retailer of technical athletic apparel, footwear and accessories, with a vision to create transformative products and experiences that build meaningful connections, unlocking greater possibility and wellbeing for all, and a purpose to elevate human potential by helping people feel their best. Since its inception it has fostered a distinctive corporate culture built on core values that include taking personal responsibility, acting with courage, valuing connection and inclusion, and choosing to have fun, and its core business is a women's range, with men's a key pillar of strategic growth and accessories an area of continued innovation and expansion. In this Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended February 1, 2026 it refers to that year as 2025 and the fiscal year ended February 2, 2025 as 2024.

Southwest Airlines Co. operates Southwest Airlines, a major passenger airline that provides scheduled air transportation in the United States and near-international markets, and commenced service on June 18, 1971 with three Boeing 737 aircraft serving three Texas cities, Dallas, Houston and San Antonio. Southwest's unique route network, competitive fares and famous Hospitality continue to make the Company an attractive choice for Customers in cities across the United States and near-international destinations, and as of December 31, 2025 it had a total of 803 Boeing 737 aircraft in its fleet and served 117 destinations in 42 states, the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, and ten near-international countries: Mexico, Jamaica, The Bahamas, Aruba, Dominican Republic, Costa Rica, Belize, Cuba, the Cayman Islands, and Turks and Caicos.

Las Vegas Sands Corp. is a Fortune 500 company and the leading global developer and operator of destination properties, known as Integrated Resorts, that feature premium accommodations, world-class gaming, entertainment and retail malls, convention and exhibition facilities, celebrity chef restaurants and other amenities. It currently owns and operates Integrated Resorts in Macao and Singapore, and it believes its geographic diversity, best-in-class properties and meeting and convention facilities provide it with the best platform in the hospitality and gaming industry to attract leisure and business tourism to its markets and continue generating growth and cash flow while simultaneously pursuing new development opportunities. The scale of its properties enables it to offer a range of amenities to serve the widest array of customer segments in each market, and it focuses on the mass market, which is its most profitable gaming segment.

LyondellBasell Industries N.V. is a global, independent chemical company, incorporated as a Naamloze Vennootschap under Dutch law on October 15, 2009, that participates globally across the petrochemical value chain and is an industry leader in many of its product lines. Its chemicals businesses consist primarily of large processing plants that convert large volumes of liquid and gaseous hydrocarbon feedstocks into plastic resins and other chemicals, and its chemical products tend to be basic building blocks for other chemicals and plastics, while its plastic products are used in large volumes as well as smaller specialty applications, with customers using its plastics and chemicals to manufacture a wide range of products people use in their everyday lives, including food packaging, home furnishings, automotive components, paints and coatings. It reports segments including Olefins and Polyolefins, Intermediates and Derivatives, Advanced Polymer Solutions and Technology.

Live Nation Entertainment, Inc. believes that it is the largest live entertainment company in the world, connecting over 805 million fans across all of its concerts and ticketing platforms in 55 countries during 2025, and believes it is the largest producer of live music concerts in the world, based on total fans that attend Live Nation events as compared to events of other promoters, connecting 159 million fans to over 11,000 artists at 55,000 events in 2025. It owns, operates, has exclusive booking rights for or has an equity interest in 460 venues globally, including House of Blues music venues and prestigious locations such as The Fillmore in San Francisco, Brooklyn Bowl in New York City, the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles, the Moody Center arena in Austin, the Ziggo Dome in Amsterdam, 3Arena in Dublin, Royal Arena in Copenhagen and Spark Arena in Auckland, and it believes it is one of the world's leading artist management companies based on the number of artists represented, investing nearly $15 billion annually in artist performances from club and theater acts to global superstars more than any other company in the industry.

Mastercard Incorporated is a technology company in the global payments industry, connecting consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments, digital partners, businesses and other organizations worldwide by enabling electronic payments and making those payment transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. It makes payments easier and more efficient by providing a wide range of payment solutions and services using its family of well-known and trusted brands, including its primary brand Mastercard, as well as its Maestro and Cirrus brands, and it operates a payments network that provides choice and flexibility for consumers, merchants and its customers, and through its unique and proprietary global payments network it switches, or authorizes, clears and settles, payment transactions, with additional payments capabilities that include automated clearing house transactions, both batch and real-time account-based payments.

Mid-America Apartment Communities, Inc., an S&P 500 company, is a multifamily-focused, self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust that owns, operates, acquires and selectively develops apartment communities primarily located in the Southeast, Southwest and Mid-Atlantic regions of the U.S. As of December 31, 2025 it maintained full or partial ownership of 302 apartment communities, including communities currently in development, across 16 states and the District of Columbia, comprising 103,083 units, of which 301 multifamily communities and 102,814 units were consolidated and one community with 269 units was unconsolidated. Its business is conducted principally through the Operating Partnership, of which it is the sole general partner holding 116,878,077 OP Units, comprising a 97.5 percent partnership interest as of December 31, 2025, and MAA and MAALP were formed in Tennessee in 1993. Its primary business objectives are to generate a sustainable, stable and increasing cash flow that will fund its dividends and distributions through all parts of the real estate investment cycle.

Marriott International, Inc. is a worldwide franchisor, operator and licensor of hotel, residential, timeshare and other lodging properties under a portfolio of compelling brands at different price and service points, and consistent with its focus on franchising, management and licensing it owns or leases very few of its lodging properties, less than one percent of its system. As of year-end 2025 its system included 9,805 properties comprising 1,779,936 rooms in 145 countries and territories, and it also had approximately 4,100 properties, nearly 610,000 rooms, in its development pipeline, and it discusses its operations in the following reportable business segments: U.S. & Canada, Europe, Middle East & Africa, Greater China, and Asia Pacific excluding China, with its Caribbean & Latin America operating segment not meeting the applicable accounting criteria for separate disclosure as a reportable business segment and its results included in Unallocated corporate and other.

Masco Corporation and its subsidiaries is a global leader in the design, manufacture and distribution of branded home improvement and building products, and its portfolio of industry-leading brands includes BEHR paint, DELTA and HANSGROHE faucets, bath and shower fixtures, LIBERTY branded decorative and functional hardware, and HOT SPRING spas, leveraging its powerful brands across product categories, sales channels and geographies to create value for its customers and shareholders. It believes its solid results of operations and financial position for 2025 resulted from its continued focus on its strategy to drive the full potential of its core businesses, leverage opportunities across its enterprise, and actively manage its portfolio, and in 2025 it continued to return value to its shareholders by repurchasing approximately 8.5 million shares of its common stock and increasing its quarterly dividend by approximately seven percent compared to 2024.

McDonald's Corporation, the registrant together with its subsidiaries, franchises and owns and operates McDonald's restaurants, which serve a locally relevant menu of quality food and beverages in communities across more than 100 countries, and of the 45,356 McDonald's restaurants at year-end 2025, approximately 95 percent were franchised. Conventional franchisees contribute to the Company's revenue primarily through the payment of rent and royalties based upon a percent of sales, with specified minimum rent payments, along with initial fees paid upon the opening of a new restaurant or grant of a new franchise, and the Company's heavily franchised business model is designed to generate stable and predictable revenue, which is largely a function of franchisee sales and resulting cash flow streams. Its reporting segments are aligned with its strategic priorities and reflect how management reviews and evaluates operating performance, with significant reportable segments including the United States and International Operated Markets, and the International Developmental Licensed Markets and Corporate segment including the results of over 75 countries as well as Corporate activities, and the Company requires franchisees to meet rigorous standards and generally does not work with passive investors.

Microchip Technology Incorporated develops, manufactures and sells smart, connected and secure embedded control solutions used by its customers for a wide variety of applications, and with over 35 years of technology leadership its broad product portfolio offers a Total System Solution for its customers that can provide a large portion of the silicon requirements in their applications, a combination of hardware, software and services which help customers increase their revenue, reduce their costs and manage their risks compared to other solutions. Its strategic focus includes general purpose and specialized mixed-signal microcontrollers, microprocessors, analog, FPGA, data center, networking, and memory products, and in July 2024 it entered the 64-bit mixed-signal microprocessor market furthering its expansion beyond 32-bit architecture, with its synergistic product portfolio empowering disruptive growth trends, including AI/ML, data centers, edge computing and IoT, E-mobility, networking and connectivity, and sustainability in key end markets.

Commencing in the second quarter of fiscal 2026, McKesson Corporation implemented a new segment reporting structure which resulted in four reportable segments: North American Pharmaceutical, Oncology & Multispecialty, Prescription Technology Solutions, and Medical-Surgical Solutions, with its former Norwegian operations included in Other, and all prior segment information recast to reflect the new segment structure and current period presentation. Its North American Pharmaceutical segment distributes branded, generic, specialty, biosimilar and over-the-counter pharmaceutical drugs, and other healthcare-related products to customers in the United States and Canada, and in addition the segment sells financial, operational and clinical solutions to pharmacies, including retail, hospital and alternate sites, and provides consulting, outsourcing, technological and other services.

Moody's Corporation, a Delaware corporation with executive offices at 7 World Trade Center in New York, provides data, insights and innovative technologies that help customers develop a holistic view of their world and unlock opportunities in a world shaped by increasingly interconnected risks, and its offerings are distinguished by vast proprietary and curated data and validated analytical models that provide the trusted foundation enabling customers to navigate an increasingly complex risk landscape. Its solutions enable the transformation of information into decision-grade intelligence, deeply interconnected across risk domains, and it also offers valuable insights into financial stability and creditworthiness for organizations, debt instruments and securities, and reports two segments, Moody's Analytics and Moody's Investors Service.

Mondelz International's purpose is to empower people to snack right, and it sells its products in over 150 countries around the world, being one of the world's largest snack companies with global net revenues of $38.5 billion and net earnings of $2.5 billion in 2025. Its core business is making and selling chocolate, biscuits and baked snacks, and it also has additional businesses in adjacent, locally relevant categories including gum & candy, cheese & grocery and powdered beverages, with a portfolio that includes iconic global and local brands such as Oreo, Ritz, LU, Clif Bar and Tate's Bake Shop biscuits and baked snacks, as well as Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka and Toblerone chocolate, and it strives to create a positive impact on the world and communities in which it operates while driving business performance, with the goal of leading the future of snacking around the world by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way.

Medtronic plc, headquartered in Galway, Ireland, is the leading global healthcare technology company, founded in 1949 and serving healthcare systems, physicians, clinicians and patients in more than 150 countries worldwide. It remains committed to a mission written by its founder in 1960 directing it to contribute to human welfare by the application of biomedical engineering in the research, design, manufacture and sale of products to alleviate pain, restore health and extend life, and it is evolving its business strategy in three key areas: accelerating innovation-driven growth, delivering value through its broad portfolio and customer relationships, and building on a strong foundation of dedication, honesty, integrity and service. Its divisions include Structural Heart & Aortic, which includes therapies to treat heart valve disorders and aortic disease such as aneurysms, dissections and transections.

MetLife, Inc., a Delaware corporation incorporated in 1999, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world's leading financial services companies, providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management. In the fourth quarter of 2025 it executed a reorganization to align with its strategic initiative to accelerate growth in asset management, and as part of that reorganization MetLife Investment Management, its institutional asset management business, which was previously reported in Corporate & Other, became a reportable segment, while MetLife Holdings was removed as a reportable segment and its business is now primarily reported in Corporate & Other, with these changes applied retrospectively for all years presented.

Meta Platforms, Inc. has a mission to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible, and its products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality headsets and AI glasses. It is innovating in artificial intelligence technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across its Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance its vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone, building technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses, and helping people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, share their experiences, ideas, photos and videos with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing its products. Meta is moving its offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform, and its wearables efforts include AI glasses such as the Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses featuring Meta AI, its advanced conversational assistant, and hands-free interaction.

MGM Resorts International is a Delaware corporation incorporated in 1986 that acts largely as a holding company and, through subsidiaries, is a global gaming and entertainment company with domestic and international locations featuring best-in-class hotels and casinos, state-of-the-art meeting and conference spaces, live and theatrical entertainment experiences, and an extensive array of restaurant, nightlife and retail offerings, as well as sports betting and online gaming operations. It believes it operates several of the finest casino properties in the world and continually reinvests in its properties to maintain its competitive advantage, making significant investments through newly remodeled hotel rooms, restaurants, entertainment and nightlife offerings, as well as other new features and amenities, and its current MGM China operations relate to MGM Macau and MGM Cotai, whose revenues are generated primarily from gaming operations conducted under a gaming concession held by MGM Grand Paradise, a subsidiary of MGM China, with gaming in Macau currently administered by the Macau Government through concessions awarded to six different concessionaires, and MGM Digital is its consolidated online gaming portfolio primarily comprised of LeoVegas.

McCormick is a global leader in flavor, manufacturing, marketing and distributing herbs, spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavorful products to the entire food and beverage industry, including retailers, food manufacturers and foodservice businesses, and it is also a partner in a number of joint ventures involved in the manufacture and sale of flavorful products, the most significant of which is McCormick de Mexico, with its major sales, distribution and production facilities located in North America, Europe and China and additional facilities based in Australia, Central America, Thailand and South Africa. On January 2, 2026 it completed the purchase of an additional 25 percent ownership interest in McCormick de Mexico for a purchase price of $750 million, which increased its ownership to a 75 percent controlling interest, and it believes the acquisition creates opportunities for further growth in the Mexican market and provides a strategic platform for further expansion in Latin America.

Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. is a leading natural resource-based building materials company, supplying aggregates, crushed stone, sand and gravel, through its network of approximately 400 quarries, mines and distribution yards in 28 states, Canada and The Bahamas, with aggregates generating 88 percent of the Company's total reportable segment gross profit in 2025. As of December 31, 2025 it also provides other building materials, namely cement, ready mixed concrete, asphalt and paving services in targeted markets where the Company has a notable aggregates position, and its heavy-side building materials are used in infrastructure, nonresidential and residential construction projects, while aggregates are also used in agricultural, utility and environmental applications and as railroad ballast, with the aggregates, cement, ready mixed concrete, asphalt and paving operations reported collectively as the Building Materials business.

3M Company, incorporated in Delaware in 1929 to continue operations begun in 1902, is a diversified technology company with a global presence. It manages its continuing operations in three reportable business segments: Safety and Industrial, Transportation and Electronics, and Consumer. Its underlying businesses include abrasives, automotive aftermarket, electrical markets, industrial adhesives and tapes, industrial specialties, personal safety, roofing granules, advanced materials, automotive and aerospace, commercial branding and transportation, display materials and systems, electronics materials solutions, consumer safety and well-being, home and auto care, home improvement, and packaging and expression. 3M describes itself as among the leading manufacturers of products for many of the markets it serves, with most of its products involving expertise in product development, manufacturing and marketing.

Based in Corona, California, Monster Beverage Corporation is a holding company and conducts no operating business except through its consolidated subsidiaries, whose primary activity is developing and marketing energy drinks, developing, marketing, selling and distributing energy drink beverages and concentrates for energy drink beverages primarily under the brand names Monster Energy, Monster Energy Ultra, Rehab Monster, Monster Energy Nitro, Java Monster, Punch Monster, Juice Monster, Reign Total Body Fuel, Reign Storm, Bang Energy, NOS and Full Throttle, among others, and it also develops, markets, sells and distributes craft beers, flavored malt beverages and hard seltzers under a number of brands, including Jai Alai IPA, Florida Man IPA, Dales Pale Ale, Wild Basin Hard Seltzers and others.

Altria Group, Inc. has a leading portfolio of tobacco products for U.S. tobacco consumers age 21 and older, and is Moving Beyond Smoking by responsibly transitioning adult smokers to a smoke-free future, competing vigorously for existing smoke-free adult nicotine consumers and exploring new growth opportunities beyond the United States and beyond nicotine. Its wholly owned subsidiaries include Philip Morris USA, engaged in the manufacture and sale of cigarettes; John Middleton, engaged in machine-made large cigars; UST and U.S. Smokeless Tobacco Company, engaged in moist smokeless tobacco products; Helix Innovations, which sells oral nicotine pouches; and NJOY, which sells e-vapor products to customers in the United States. Substantially all of its oral tobacco products are manufactured and sold in the United States.

The Mosaic Company is the world's leading producer and marketer of concentrated phosphate and potash crop nutrients, and through its broad product offering it is a single source supplier of phosphate- and potash-based crop nutrients and animal feed ingredients, serving customers in approximately 40 countries. It is the second largest integrated phosphate producer in the world and one of the largest producers and marketers of phosphate-based animal feed ingredients in North America and Brazil, the leading fertilizer production and distribution company in Brazil, mining phosphate rock in Florida, Brazil and Peru and processing rock into finished phosphate products at facilities in Florida, Louisiana and Brazil, and is typically one of the top four global potash producers in the world, mining potash in Saskatchewan and New Mexico, with other production, blending or distribution operations in Brazil, China, India and Paraguay, and its operations serve the top four nutrient-consuming countries in the world.

Marathon Petroleum Corporation has nearly 140 years of history in the energy business and is a leading, integrated, downstream and midstream energy company, operating one of the nation's largest refining systems with approximately 3.0 million barrels per day of crude oil refining capacity, and it believes it is one of the largest wholesale suppliers of gasoline and distillates to resellers in the United States, distributing its refined products through one of the largest terminal operations in the United States and one of the largest private domestic fleets of inland petroleum product barges, while its integrated midstream energy asset network links producers of natural gas and NGLs from some of the largest supply basins in the United States to domestic and international markets, and it is also one of the largest producers and marketers of renewable diesel in the United States, with operations consisting of three reportable operating segments: Refining & Marketing, Midstream and Renewable Diesel.

Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. is a fabless global company that provides high-performance, semiconductor-based power electronics solutions, incorporated in 1997, with its three core strengths including deep system-level knowledge, strong semiconductor design expertise, and innovative proprietary technologies in the areas of semiconductor processes, system integration and packaging, which combined enable it to deliver reliable, compact and monolithic solutions found in storage and computing, enterprise data, automotive, industrial, communications and consumer applications. Its mission is to reduce energy and material consumption to improve all aspects of quality of life and create a sustainable future, and it believes it differentiates itself by offering solutions that are more highly integrated, smaller in size, more energy-efficient, more accurate and more reliable with respect to performance specifications and, consequently, more cost-effective than many competing solutions.

Merck & Co., Inc. is a global health care company that delivers innovative health solutions through its prescription medicines, including biologic therapies, vaccines and animal health products, with operations principally managed on a product basis across two operating and reportable segments, Pharmaceutical and Animal Health. The Pharmaceutical segment includes human health pharmaceutical and vaccine products, where human health pharmaceutical products consist of therapeutic and preventive agents, generally sold by prescription, for the treatment of human disorders, sold primarily to drug wholesalers and retailers, hospitals, government agencies and managed health care providers such as health maintenance organizations and pharmacy benefit managers, and human health vaccine products consist of preventive pediatric, adolescent and adult vaccines sold primarily to physicians, wholesalers, distributors and government programs.

Moderna, Inc. is a pioneer and leader in the field of mRNA medicine, and through the advancement of its technology platform it is reimagining how medicines are made to transform how it treats and prevents diseases, with its mRNA platform having enabled the development of vaccine and therapeutic candidates across infectious disease, oncology, rare disease and more since its founding. With a global team and a unique culture, driven by its values and mindsets, its mission is to deliver the greatest possible impact to people through mRNA medicines. It currently has three commercial products, Spikevax and mNEXSPIKE, its COVID vaccines, and mRESVIA, its vaccine against respiratory syncytial virus, with mNEXSPIKE, launched commercially in the third quarter of 2025, now its leading product in the U.S. retail channel, and in 2025 it achieved total revenue of $1.9 billion, largely from sales of its COVID vaccines.

Marsh & McLennan Companies, Inc., effective January 14, 2026 updated its brand name from Marsh McLennan to Marsh and the brand names of its Marsh and Oliver Wyman Group businesses to Marsh Risk and Marsh Management Consulting, respectively, with Mercer and Guy Carpenter continuing to report under their current brands through a transition period. Marsh is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries, and with an annual revenue of $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues it helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective, conducting business through two segments, Risk and Insurance Services and Consulting, with businesses including Insurance Broking and Risk Advisory, where Marsh Risk offers risk analysis, insurance program design, claims support and alternative risk strategies, Risk Management and Specialty, plus Marsh McLennan Agency which provides business insurance, employee health and benefits, retirement and wealth management and private client insurance solutions.

Marvell Technology, Inc., together with its consolidated subsidiaries, is a leading supplier of data infrastructure semiconductor solutions, spanning the data center core to network edge, and is a fabless supplier of high-performance semiconductor products with core strengths in developing and scaling complex System-on-a-Chip architectures, integrating analog, mixed-signal and digital signal processing functionality, leveraging leading intellectual property and deep system-level expertise, as well as highly innovative security firmware, to empower the data economy and enable the data center and communications and other end markets. It is incorporated in Delaware with corporate headquarters at 1000 N. West Street, Suite 1200, Wilmington, Delaware, and has operations in many countries, including Argentina, China, India, Israel, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam, serving end markets including cloud and on-premise ethernet switching, network-attached storage, AI servers, general-purpose servers, storage systems, data center interconnect, enterprise networking, campus and small medium enterprise routers, switches and wireless access points, and network appliances such as firewalls and load balancers.

Morgan Stanley is a global financial services firm that, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, advises, and originates, trades, manages and distributes capital for governments, institutions and individuals. It was originally incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware in 1981 and its predecessor companies date back to 1924, and it is a financial holding company regulated by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System under the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956, as amended, conducting its business from its headquarters in and around New York City, its regional offices and branches throughout the U.S. and its principal offices in London, Frankfurt, Tokyo, Hong Kong and other world financial centers.

MSCI Inc.'s research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help its clients understand risks and opportunities, make better investment decisions and unlock innovation. Investors all over the world use its tools and solutions to gain insights and improve transparency throughout their investment processes, with offerings that help them define their investment universe, make asset allocation decisions, construct and analyze portfolios and investment strategies, identify, measure and manage drivers of investment risk and performance, integrate sustainability and climate considerations into portfolio construction and risk management, design and manage indexed financial products such as exchange-traded funds, and prepare regulatory and client reports, and its products and services include indexes, portfolio construction and risk management analytical models and tools, sustainability and climate solutions, and private asset data and analytics.

Microsoft is a technology company committed to making digital technology and artificial intelligence available broadly and doing so responsibly, with a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. It develops and supports a broad portfolio of technology solutions for individuals and businesses, focusing on secure, trusted and innovative platforms and applications that meet evolving customer needs across AI, cloud computing, productivity and collaboration, and personal computing, and it strives to create opportunity, growth and impact in every country around the world. AI is fundamentally transforming productivity for every individual, organization and industry, and Microsoft's AI offerings span every layer of the technology stack, enabling transformative outcomes across sectors and unlocking opportunity for every country, community and individual, with the company believing AI should be as empowering as it is powerful and committing to designing and deploying AI responsibly.

Motorola Solutions is a global leader in mission-critical safety and security technologies for public safety, government, including defense, and enterprise customers, with its business focused on safety and security, driven by its commitment to help create safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses and ultimately safer nations, and grounded in nearly 100 years of close customer and community collaboration, it designs and advances technology for more than 100,000 customers in over 100 countries with the goal of making everywhere safer for all. Its ecosystem of safety and security technologies includes Mission Critical Networks, Video Security and Access Control and Command Center, and its strategy is to generate value through its technologies that help meet the changing needs of its customers around the world in protecting people, property and places, and it reports two segments, Products and Systems Integration and Software and Services.

M&T Bank Corporation is a New York business corporation that has elected to be treated as a financial holding company under the Bank Holding Company Act and is a bank holding company under Article III-A of the New York Banking Law, and it was incorporated in November 1969. At December 31, 2025 it had two wholly-owned bank subsidiaries, M&T Bank and Wilmington Trust, N.A., which collectively offer a wide range of retail and commercial banking, wealth management, trust and institutional services to their customers, and the company had consolidated total assets of $213.5 billion, deposits of $166.9 billion and shareholders' equity of $29.2 billion at that date, with its principal executive offices located in Buffalo, New York. M&T Bank is a banking corporation incorporated under the laws of the State of New York, a member of the Federal Reserve System and the FHLB System, with its deposits insured by the FDIC through its DIF up to applicable limits.

Mettler-Toledo International Inc. is a leading global supplier of precision instruments and services, with strong leadership positions in all of its businesses and holding global number-one market positions in most of them, and it is recognized as an innovation leader whose solutions are critical in key research and development, quality control and manufacturing processes for customers in a wide range of industries including life sciences, food and chemicals. Its sales and service network is one of the most extensive in the industry, with products sold in more than 140 countries and a direct presence in approximately 40 countries, and its business is geographically diversified, with net sales in 2025 derived 42 percent from North and South America, 29 percent from Europe and 29 percent from Asia and other countries, and a customer base diversified by industry and by individual end-customer.

Micron Technology, Inc. is an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all, and with a relentless focus on customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence it delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND and NOR memory and storage products through its Micron and Crucial brands, with the innovations its people create fueling the data economy and enabling advances in artificial intelligence and compute-intensive applications that unleash opportunities from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience. It manufactures its products at wholly-owned facilities and also utilizes subcontractors for certain manufacturing processes, and its global network of manufacturing centers of excellence allows it to benefit from scale while streamlining processes and operations and brings together some of the world's brightest talent to work on the most advanced memory technology. In 2025 it began shipping the industry's first 1-gamma production node, its first DRAM node incorporating EUV lithography, and its High-Bandwidth Memory is a 3D stacked DRAM architecture that uses through-silicon via connections for more efficient communication.

Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. traces its operations to 1966, when Norwegian commenced operations from Miami, Florida, launching the modern cruise industry by offering weekly departures from Miami to destinations in the Caribbean. NCLH, a Bermuda limited company, was formed in February 2011, and in January 2013 it completed its initial public offering and the ordinary shares of NCLC were exchanged for the ordinary shares of NCLH, with NCLH becoming the owner of 100 percent of the ordinary shares and parent company of NCLC, and in November 2014 it completed the acquisition of PCI. In late 2023, in response to the OECD's BEPS 2.0 Pillar 2 global tax reform, the Company restructured its organizational structure by realigning many of its operations across its three different brands into a single jurisdiction, Bermuda, and its fleet includes ships such as Norwegian Bliss, Joy, Escape, Getaway, Viva, Prima and Encore.

Nasdaq is a leading technology platform that powers the world's economies, architecting the infrastructure of the world's most modern markets, powering the innovation economy and building trust in the financial system, and empowering economic opportunity by designing and deploying the technology, data and advanced analytics that enable its clients to capture opportunities, navigate risk and strengthen resilience. It manages, operates and provides its products and services in three business segments, Capital Access Platforms, Financial Technology and Market Services, and was founded in 1971 as a wholly-owned subsidiary of FINRA, with ownership broadened beginning in 2000 when FINRA restructured and began selling shares to FINRA members, investment companies and issuers listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market.

Nordson is an innovative precision technology company that leverages a scalable growth framework to deliver top tier growth with leading margins and returns, engineering, manufacturing and marketing differentiated products and systems used for precision dispensing, applying and controlling of adhesives, coatings, polymers, sealants, biomaterials and other fluids, to test and inspect for quality, and to treat and cure surfaces and various medical products such as catheters, cannulas, medical balloons and medical tubing, with these products supported with extensive application expertise and direct global sales and service. It serves a wide variety of consumer non-durable, consumer durable and technology end markets including packaging, electronics, medical, appliances, energy, transportation, precision agriculture, building and construction, and general product assembly and finishing, and its strategy for long-term growth is based on solving customers' needs globally, with its operating segments including Industrial Precision Solutions and Medical and Fluid Solutions.

NextEra Energy, Inc. is one of the largest electric power and energy infrastructure companies in North America, and as of December 31, 2025 it had approximately 80 gigawatts of net generation and storage capacity from a diverse portfolio of assets, primarily including natural gas, wind, solar and nuclear generation facilities and battery storage facilities. It has two principal businesses, FPL and NEER: FPL is the largest electric utility in Florida and the U.S., whose strategic focus is centered on investing in generation, storage, transmission and distribution facilities to deliver on its value proposition of keeping customer bills low and delivering high reliability, outstanding customer service and energy from diverse generation sources for the benefit of its more than six million customer accounts, and NEER is one of the largest energy infrastructure developers in the U.S., whose strategic focus is centered on the development, construction and operation of long-term contracted generation facilities, including renewables, nuclear and natural gas, as well as battery storage facilities.

Newmont Corporation was incorporated in 1921 and is primarily a gold producer with significant operations and/or assets in the United States, Papua New Guinea, Australia, Ghana, Suriname, Argentina, Dominican Republic, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Mexico and Canada. At December 31, 2025 Newmont had attributable proven and probable gold reserves of 118.2 million ounces, attributable measured and indicated gold resources of 88.1 million ounces, attributable inferred gold resources of 60.6 million ounces, and an aggregate land position of approximately 19,200 square miles, and it is also engaged in the production of copper, silver, lead and zinc. As the world's leading gold company it remains committed to creating value and improving lives through sustainable and responsible mining, and its corporate headquarters are in Denver, Colorado.

Netflix, Inc. is one of the world's leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages, with members able to play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and to change their plans at any time. Its core strategy is to grow its business globally within the parameters of its operating margin target, striving to continuously improve members' experience by offering compelling content that delights them and attracts new members, aiming to offer a range of pricing plans including an ad-supported subscription plan to meet a variety of consumer needs, seeking to drive conversation around its content to further enhance member joy and continuously enhancing its user interface to help members more easily choose content. It operates as one operating segment, and its revenues are primarily derived from monthly membership fees for services related to streaming content.

NiSource Inc. is an energy holding company under the Public Utility Holding Company Act of 2005 whose primary subsidiaries are fully regulated natural gas and electric utility companies, serving approximately 3.8 million customers in six states. NiSource is the successor to an Indiana corporation organized in 1987 under the name of NIPSCO Industries, Inc., which changed its name to NiSource Inc. on April 14, 1999. Its principal subsidiaries include NiSource Gas Distribution Group, Inc., a holding company that owns Columbia of Kentucky, Columbia of Maryland, Columbia of Ohio, Columbia of Pennsylvania and Columbia of Virginia, and NIPSCO Holdings I, a holding company that owns a controlling interest in NIPSCO, a gas and electric utility, and it derives substantially all of its revenues and earnings from the operating results of these rate-regulated businesses. In addition it will develop the generation resources it plans to use in serving data center customers through its subsidiary Generation Holdings I.

NIKE, Inc., incorporated in 1967 under the laws of the State of Oregon, has as its principal business activity the design, development and worldwide marketing and selling of athletic footwear, apparel, equipment, accessories and services, and it is the largest seller of athletic footwear and apparel in the world. It sells its products through NIKE Direct operations, comprised of both NIKE-owned retail stores and sales through its digital platforms, and to wholesale accounts, which include a mix of independent distributors, licensees and sales representatives in nearly all countries around the world, and it also offers interactive consumer services and experiences, with nearly all of its products manufactured by independent contractors.

Northrop Grumman Corporation is a leading global aerospace and defense technology company that delivers a broad range of products, services and solutions to U.S. and international customers, and principally to the U.S. Department of War and the intelligence community. Its broad portfolio is aligned to support national security priorities and its solutions equip customers with the capabilities they need to connect, protect and advance humanity, and it is a leading provider of space systems, military aircraft, missile defense, advanced weapons and long-range fires capabilities, mission systems, networking and communications, strategic deterrence systems, and breakthrough technologies such as advanced computing, microelectronics and cyber, focusing on competing and winning programs that enable continued growth, performing on its commitments and affordably delivering the capability its customers need.

ServiceNow delivers solutions that help public and private organizations govern, secure and manage artificial intelligence and digitalize and streamline workflows to drive collaboration, productivity and better experiences across the enterprise, offering an innovative suite of products, including AI-powered applications, and services designed to automate workflows, integrate systems and empower employees, regardless of existing systems, cloud environments or collaboration tools, and at the core of these solutions is the ServiceNow AI Platform, a robust, cloud-based platform that facilitates comprehensive delivery of seamless workflows and drives digital transformation across all departments and personas within an organization, with its products grouped into four areas, Technology, Customer Relationship Management and Industry, Core Business, and Creator and Other, and it releasing two major Platform upgrades each year, adding new products and functionality that simplify work and enhance productivity.

NRG Energy, Inc. serves electricity, natural gas and smart-home technology solutions to approximately 8 million residential customers, comprised of 6 million retail energy and 2 million smart home, in addition to large commercial and industrial, data center and wholesale customers, and across North America it is redefining customers' experience with energy under brand names such as NRG, Reliant, Direct Energy, Green Mountain Energy and Vivint. As of December 31, 2025, its core power and natural gas business consists of approximately 12 GW of competitive power generation, primarily in Texas, and a natural gas portfolio that serves approximately 1,900 MMDth annually, and to effectuate its strategy NRG is focused on serving the energy needs of residential, commercial and industrial and wholesale counterparties in competitive markets and optimizing additional revenue opportunities through its multiple brands and channels, offering differentiated energy and smart home products and services, excellence in operating performance of its assets, achieving the optimal mix of supply to serve customer load requirements through a diversified supply strategy, and engaging in disciplined and transparent capital allocation.

Norfolk Southern Corporation is an Atlanta, Georgia-based company that owns a major freight railroad, Norfolk Southern Railway Company, and it was incorporated on July 23, 1980 under the laws of the Commonwealth of Virginia, with its common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol NSC. It is primarily engaged in the rail transportation of raw materials, intermediate products and finished goods primarily in the Southeast, East and Midwest and, via interchange with rail carriers, to and from the rest of the United States, and it also transports overseas freight through several Atlantic and Gulf Coast ports, offering the most extensive intermodal network in the eastern half of the U.S.

NetApp, Inc., headquartered in San Jose, California, is a global leader in Intelligent Data Infrastructure, and since its founding in 1992 it has transformed from a pioneering storage hardware provider into a software-driven, cloud-centric data infrastructure company. Its flagship ONTAP data management software, together with a comprehensive portfolio of all-flash, hybrid-flash and cloud-native solutions, forms the backbone of digital transformation for thousands of enterprises worldwide, and it empowers organizations to manage, protect and leverage data across on-premises, hybrid and multi-cloud environments, and is well positioned to enable Intelligent Data Infrastructure for its customers and help them realize the full promise of artificial intelligence by providing solutions that connect, protect and activate data across every data environment on-premises, in the cloud and at the edge.

Northern Trust Corporation is a leading provider of wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking solutions to corporations, institutions, families and individuals, and is a financial holding company conducting business through various U.S. and non-U.S. subsidiaries, including The Northern Trust Company. The Bank is an Illinois banking corporation headquartered in Chicago and the Corporation's principal subsidiary, founded in 1889, and at December 31, 2025 the Bank had consolidated assets of $176.4 billion and common bank equity capital of $11.4 billion, while the Corporation was formed as a holding company for the Bank in 1971 and has a global presence with offices in 24 U.S. states and Washington, D.C., and across 22 locations in Canada, Europe, the Middle East and the Asia-Pacific region, with consolidated total assets of $177.1 billion at December 31, 2025.

Nucor Corporation, a Delaware corporation incorporated in 1958, and its affiliates manufacture steel and steel products, and the company also produces and procures ferrous and non-ferrous materials primarily for use in its steel manufacturing business, with most of its operating facilities and customers located in North America and its operations including international trading and sales companies that buy and sell steel and steel products manufactured by the company and others. Nucor is North America's largest recycler, using scrap steel as the primary raw material in producing steel and steel products, and in 2025 it recycled approximately 20 million gross tons of scrap steel. It reports its results in three segments, steel mills, steel products and raw materials, with the steel mills segment its largest, representing 62 percent of sales to external customers in the year ended December 31, 2025.

NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems and is now a data center scale AI infrastructure company reshaping all industries. Its technology stack includes the foundational NVIDIA CUDA development platform that runs on all NVIDIA GPUs, as well as hundreds of domain-specific software libraries, frameworks, algorithms, software development kits and application programming interfaces, and this deep and broad software stack accelerates the performance and facilitates the deployment of NVIDIA accelerated computing for computationally intensive workloads such as artificial intelligence, model training and inference, data analytics, scientific computing, robotics and 3D graphics, with vertical-specific optimizations to address industries ranging from healthcare and telecom to automotive and manufacturing. Introduced with the Blackwell architecture, its data-center-scale offerings feature extreme co-design where the infrastructure's chips, networking, systems, software and algorithms are optimized together, and its Data Center infrastructure systems include supercomputing platforms and servers bringing together higher-performance, energy-efficient GPUs, CPUs and interconnects with fully optimized AI and HPC software stacks, while its networking offerings include NVLink interconnects and switches and end-to-end InfiniBand and Ethernet platforms.

NVR, Inc., a Virginia corporation formed in 1980 as NVHomes, Inc., has as its primary business the construction and sale of single-family detached homes, townhomes and condominium buildings, all of which are primarily constructed on a pre-sold basis, and to more fully serve customers of its homebuilding operations it also operates a mortgage banking and title services business through a wholly owned subsidiary, NVR Mortgage Finance, Inc. It conducts its homebuilding activities directly and is one of the largest homebuilders in the United States, operating in thirty-seven metropolitan areas in sixteen states and Washington, D.C., with homebuilding operations under three trade names, Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes, and its backlog, representing homes sold but not yet settled, totaled 8,448 units and approximately $4.0 billion as of December 31, 2025.

News Corporation is a global, diversified media and information services company focused on creating and distributing authoritative and engaging content and other products and services to consumers and businesses throughout the world, comprising businesses across a range of media, including information services and news, digital real estate services and book publishing, that are distributed under some of the world's most recognizable and respected brands, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, Dow Jones, The Australian, Herald Sun, The Sun, The Times, HarperCollins Publishers, realestate.com.au, Realtor.com and talkSPORT. Its commitment to premium content makes its properties a premier destination for information, news, real estate and entertainment, and it distributes its content and other products and services to consumers and customers across an array of digital platforms including websites, mobile apps, social media, e-book devices and streaming audio.

News Corporation is a global, diversified media and information services company focused on creating and distributing authoritative and engaging content and other products and services to consumers and businesses throughout the world, comprising businesses across a range of media, including information services and news, digital real estate services and book publishing, that are distributed under some of the world's most recognizable and respected brands, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, Dow Jones, The Australian, Herald Sun, The Sun, The Times, HarperCollins Publishers, realestate.com.au, Realtor.com, talkSPORT and many others.

NXP Semiconductors N.V. is a global semiconductor company and a long-standing supplier in the industry, with over 70 years of innovation and operating history, generating revenue of $12,269 million for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to $12,614 million for the year ended December 31, 2024. It provides leading solutions that leverage its combined portfolio of intellectual property, deep application knowledge, process technology and manufacturing expertise in the domains of embedded processing, mixed-signal analog-digital, power management, digital signal processing, cryptography-security, high-speed interface, radio frequency and embedded system design, and its product solutions are used in a wide range of end market applications including automotive, industrial and Internet of Things, mobile and communication infrastructure, engaging with leading global companies and selling products in all major geographic regions.

Realty Income Corporation, an S&P 500 company, describes itself as the real estate partner to the world's leading companies, and founded in 1969 it serves its clients as a full-service real estate capital provider, with a portfolio of over 15,500 properties in all 50 states of the United States, the United Kingdom and eight other countries in Europe as of December 31, 2025. It is known as The Monthly Dividend Company and has a mission to invest in people and places to deliver dependable monthly dividends that increase over time, and since its listing on the NYSE in 1994 it has had 133 dividend increases and is a member of the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats index for having increased its dividend for over 31 consecutive years, with geographic expansion an important component of its investment strategy, where as of December 31, 2025 its U.K. and European assets represented approximately 19 percent of its annualized base rent compared to approximately 14 percent as of December 31, 2024.

Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. is one of the largest North American less-than-truckload (LTL) motor carriers, providing regional, inter-regional and national LTL services through a single integrated, union-free organization, with service offerings that include expedited transportation provided through an expansive network of service centers located throughout the continental United States, and through strategic alliances it also provides LTL services throughout North America. In addition to its core LTL services, it offers a range of value-added services including container drayage, truckload brokerage and supply chain consulting, and more than 98 percent of its revenue has historically been derived from transporting LTL shipments for its customers, whose demand for its services is generally tied to industrial production and the overall health of the U.S. domestic economy.

ONEOK, Inc. is incorporated under the laws of the state of Oklahoma with its common stock listed on the NYSE under the trading symbol OKE, and it delivers energy products and services vital to an advancing world as a leading midstream service provider of gathering, processing, fractionation, transportation, storage and marine export services, and as one of the largest integrated energy infrastructure companies in North America it delivers energy that makes a difference in the lives of people in the U.S. and around the world, transporting through its approximately 60,000-mile pipeline network the natural gas, NGLs, refined products and crude oil that help meet domestic and international energy demand, contribute to energy security and provide safe, reliable and responsible energy solutions needed today and into the future.

Omnicom Group Inc. is a leading global advertising and marketing services company, providing brand advertising, brand consulting, media planning and buying, branding, merchandising and point of sale, content marketing, mobile marketing, crisis communications, multi-cultural marketing, customer data analytics and data-driven decision making, organizational communications, customer relationship management, package design, decision sciences and performance marketing.
