On November 26, 2025 it completed its merger with IPG, with IPG becoming a direct wholly owned subsidiary of Omnicom and each outstanding share of IPG common stock, other than certain excluded shares, converting into the right to receive 0.344 shares of Omnicom common stock and cash in lieu of fractional shares, following which legacy Omnicom shareholders owned approximately 60.6 percent of the combined company and legacy IPG shareholders owned approximately 39.4 percent, on a fully diluted basis.

ON Semiconductor Corporation, together with its wholly and majority-owned subsidiaries, which operate under the onsemi brand, was incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware in 1992, and offers intelligent power and intelligent sensing solutions that drive electrification, energy efficiency, safety and automation in automotive, industrial and other end-markets, including AI data center. Its intelligent power technologies enable the electrification of drivetrain in the automotive industry to allow for lighter and longer-range electric vehicles and empower efficient fast-charging systems, while its intelligent sensing technologies enable advanced safety applications in automotive through industry leading performance and reliability, and it believes the evolution of the automotive industry, with advancements in autonomous driving, ADAS, vehicle electrification and the increase in electronics content for vehicle platforms, is reshaping the boundaries of transportation.

Oracle Corporation provides products and services that build, run and support enterprise information technology frameworks, with its products and services including enterprise applications and infrastructure offerings that incorporate and are enhanced by artificial intelligence technologies, including embedded AI-driven automation and analytics and generative AI capabilities, delivered worldwide through a variety of flexible and interoperable IT deployment models, including cloud-based, on-premise and hybrid deployments, such as Oracle Exadata Cloud@Customer and multicloud options that enable customers to use Oracle cloud offerings in conjunction with other public clouds, providing choice and flexibility to customers as to when and how they deploy Oracle applications and infrastructure technologies, which it believes is important to its growth strategy.

O'Reilly Automotive, Inc. states its goal is to continue to achieve growth in sales and profitability by capitalizing on its competitive advantages and executing its growth strategies, remaining confident in its ability to continue to gain market share in its existing markets and grow its business in new markets by focusing on its dual market strategy and core values including hard work, superior customer service and expense control, with a mission to be the dominant auto parts provider in all the markets it serves by providing a higher level of customer service and a better value position than its competitors to both DIY and professional service provider customers. It believes its effective dual market strategy, superior customer service, technically proficient store personnel, strategic distribution network and experienced management team make up its key competitive advantages, which cannot be easily duplicated, and for more than 45 years it has established a track record of effectively serving, at a high level, both DIY and professional service provider customers.

Otis is the world's leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, service and modernization company, serving customers in over 200 countries and territories around the world, with global scale and local focus, more than 1,400 branches and offices and a direct physical presence in more than 70 countries. It is a Delaware corporation incorporated on March 1, 2019 in connection with the separation and distribution of each of Otis and Carrier Global Corporation from United Technologies Corporation, subsequently renamed RTX Corporation, into separate independent publicly traded companies, with the Separation occurring on April 3, 2020, and it completed the Separation pursuant to a Separation and Distribution Agreement and other agreements with UTC and Carrier related to the Separation, including a tax matters agreement, an employee matter agreement and an intellectual property agreement.

Occidental Petroleum Corporation, a Delaware corporation with executive offices at 5 Greenway Plaza in Houston, Texas, is an international energy company recognized for its premier diversified assets, primarily situated in the United States, the Middle East and North Africa, whose distinguished operational capabilities support sustainable value creation for shareholders. The Company ranks among the largest oil and gas producers in the U.S., holding leading positions in the Permian and DJ Basins as well as offshore Gulf of America, and is the largest independent oil producer in Oman, its midstream and marketing segment ensures flow assurance and optimizes the value of oil and gas operations, and Oxy Low Carbon Ventures, a subsidiary within the midstream and marketing segment, focuses on carbon capture and storage and other low-carbon ventures.

Everpure, Inc., formerly known as Pure Storage, is a global technology company providing an integrated storage and data management platform, and views data as foundational to its customers' business transformation and increasingly central to their operational resilience and competitive differentiation. It began as a provider of flash-based storage systems and has evolved into a company that delivers a cloud experience with an intelligent, unified storage and data management platform, the Everpure Platform, that virtualizes data across on-premises, hybrid and public cloud, and edge environments into a single storage layer with consistent control, built-in automation and continuous modernization, and it is executing a focused strategy to modernize and simplify data infrastructure for customers as AI adoption increases.

Palo Alto Networks, Inc. is a global artificial intelligence cybersecurity provider whose vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before, and it was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California. Its mission is to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting its digital way of life, and its platforms and services help secure enterprise users, networks, clouds, endpoints, AI apps and agents, and identities by delivering comprehensive cybersecurity backed by AI and automation, and provide real-time visibility and monitoring across cloud infrastructure, applications and AI workloads. A key element of its strategy is to help customers simplify their security architectures through consolidating disparate point products, executed by developing its capabilities and packaging its offerings into platforms able to cover many of its customers' needs in the markets in which it operates.

Paychex, Inc., a Delaware corporation incorporated in 1979 that maintains dual corporate headquarters in Rochester, New York and Cincinnati, Ohio and has a fiscal year that ends on May 31st, is an industry-leading human capital management company providing comprehensive technology and advisory solutions in human resources, payroll processing, employee benefits and insurance. As of May 31, 2026 it served approximately 840,000 total customers across the U.S. and parts of Europe, of which approximately 800,000 are payroll clients, and it continues to invest significantly in its proprietary technology, HCM platforms, advisory solutions and benefits to maximize value for its customers and their employees, believing it is well positioned to capitalize on AI opportunities through its large and growing data sets, predictive analytics and AI models, and continued investments to increase efficiency, enhance the customer experience, support better outcomes and create growth opportunities.

PACCAR Inc, incorporated under the laws of Delaware in 1971 as the successor to Pacific Car and Foundry Company which was incorporated in Washington in 1924, with predecessors tracing to Seattle Car Manufacturing Company formed in 1905, is a multinational company operating in three principal industry segments: the Truck segment, including the design, manufacture and distribution of high-quality light-, medium- and heavy-duty commercial trucks, where heavy-duty trucks have a gross vehicle weight of over 33,000 lbs in North America and over 16 metric tonnes in Europe and South America and are configured with the engine in front of the cab or cab-over-engine; the Parts segment, including the distribution of aftermarket parts for trucks and related commercial vehicles to over 2,000 Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF dealers and more than 350 TRP aftermarket parts stores in 99 countries; and Financial Services.

PG&E Corporation, incorporated in California in 1995, is a holding company whose primary operating subsidiary is Pacific Gas and Electric Company, a public utility operating in Northern and Central California, and the Utility was incorporated in California in 1905, with PG&E Corporation becoming the holding company of the Utility and its subsidiaries in 1997. The Utility generates revenues mainly through the sale and delivery of electricity and natural gas to customers, and the principal executive offices of both PG&E Corporation and the Utility are located at 300 Lakeside Drive in Oakland, California. This is a combined Annual Report on Form 10-K for PG&E Corporation and the Utility, which are separate entities.

Public Service Enterprise Group Incorporated, incorporated under the laws of the State of New Jersey in 1985 with principal executive offices at 80 Park Plaza in Newark, New Jersey, is a public utility holding company that, acting through its wholly owned subsidiaries, is a predominantly regulated electric and gas utility and a nuclear generation business, and its business plan focuses on achieving growth by allocating capital primarily toward regulated investments in an effort to continue to improve the sustainability and predictability of its business and realizing the value of the consistent and reliable carbon-free generation from its nuclear units. It principally conducts its business through two direct wholly owned subsidiaries, PSE&G, a New Jersey corporation incorporated in 1924 which is a franchised public utility in New Jersey, a transmission owner in PJM, and a provider of distribution service to 2.4 million electric customers and 1.9 million gas customers in a service area covering approximately 2,600 square miles across New Jersey, and PSEG Power, its nuclear generation business.

PepsiCo, Inc., incorporated in Delaware in 1919 and reincorporated in North Carolina in 1986, is a leading global beverage and convenient food company with a complementary portfolio of brands, including Lay's, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker and SodaStream. Through its operations, authorized bottlers, contract manufacturers and other third parties, it makes, markets, distributes and sells a wide variety of beverages and convenient foods, serving customers and consumers in more than 200 countries and territories, and it is organized into six reportable segments, beginning with PepsiCo Foods North America, which includes all of its convenient food businesses in the United States and Canada, and PepsiCo Beverages North America, which includes all of its beverage businesses in the United States and Canada.

Pfizer Inc. is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company that applies science and its global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives through the discovery, development, manufacture, marketing, sale and distribution of biopharmaceutical products worldwide. It works across developed and emerging markets to advance wellness, prevention, treatments and cures that challenge the most feared diseases of its time, and collaborates with healthcare providers, governments and local communities to support and expand access to reliable, affordable healthcare around the world. The Company was incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware on June 2, 1942, most of its revenues come from the manufacture and sale of biopharmaceutical products, and it manages its commercial operations through a global structure consisting of three operating segments, each led by a single manager: Biopharma, PC1 and Pfizer Ignite.

Principal Financial Group, Inc. is a leader in global financial services offering businesses, individuals and institutional clients a wide range of financial products and services, including retirement, asset management and workplace benefits and protection solutions through its diverse family of financial services companies, and it had $1,814.6 billion in assets under administration, including $781.0 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2025. Its global asset management businesses serve a broad range of institutional, retirement, high net worth and retail investors worldwide, with focused investment teams providing diverse, long-term investment capabilities including equity, fixed income, real estate and other alternative investments as well as fund offerings, and its international asset management and accumulation businesses focus on the opportunities created as aging populations around the world drive increased demand for retirement accumulation, retirement asset management and retirement income management solutions.

The Procter & Gamble Company is a world-leading multinational consumer goods company focused on providing trusted, branded products of superior quality, performance and value to improve the lives of consumers around the world, now and for generations to come, with its products sold in about 180 countries and territories throughout the world. It was incorporated in Ohio in 1905, having first been established as a New Jersey corporation in 1890, and was built from a business founded in Cincinnati in 1837 by William Procter and James Gamble.

The Progressive Corporation, an insurance holding company, has insurance and non-insurance subsidiaries and affiliates, and its insurance subsidiaries write personal and commercial auto insurance, personal residential property insurance, and insurance for motorcycles, watercraft and other recreational vehicles, while it also offers business-related general liability and commercial property insurance predominantly for small businesses, workers compensation insurance primarily for the transportation industry, and other specialty property-casualty insurance and related services. Its non-insurance subsidiaries generally support its insurance and investment operations, and it operates throughout the United States, with The Progressive Corporation together with its insurance and non-insurance subsidiaries comprising what it refers to as Progressive, and it believes it is the market share leader for both motorcycle and boat products and one of the largest providers of RV insurance.

Parker-Hannifin Corporation, incorporated in Ohio in 1938, is a global leader in motion and control technologies, and leveraging a unique combination of interconnected technologies it designs, manufactures and provides aftermarket support for highly engineered solutions that create value for customers primarily in aerospace and defense, in-plant and industrial equipment, transportation, off-highway, energy, and HVAC and refrigeration markets around the world. It values having a decentralized operating structure that fosters deeper connections with its customers and greater engagement among its team members, and to align its operations and achieve its goal of top quartile performance it deploys its business system, The Win Strategy, which establishes goals and strategies for engaged people, customers and suppliers.

PulteGroup, Inc. is a Michigan corporation organized in 1956, though it dates its founding to 1950 when its founder, Bill Pulte, built its first home, and over its history it has delivered over 875,000 homes. It is one of the largest homebuilders in the United States, and its common shares are included in the S&P 500 Index and trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol PHM. While its subsidiaries engage primarily in the homebuilding business, it also has financial services businesses, which include mortgage banking, title and insurance agency operations, through Pulte Mortgage LLC and other subsidiaries.

Packaging Corporation of America is the third largest producer of containerboard products and a leading producer of uncoated freesheet paper in North America, operating ten mills and 91 corrugated products plants and related facilities and headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois, and it reports in three reportable segments, Packaging, Paper and Corporate and Other. On September 2, 2025 it completed the acquisition of the containerboard business of Greif, Inc. for $1.8 billion in cash, a business that includes two containerboard mills with approximately 800,000 tons of production capacity and eight sheet feeder and corrugated plants located across the United States.

Prologis, Inc. is a self-administered and self-managed REIT and the sole general partner of Prologis, L.P., through which it holds substantially all of its assets, and it operates Prologis, Inc. and Prologis, L.P. as one enterprise. It began operating as a fully integrated real estate company in 1997 and elected to be taxed as a REIT under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, and it invests in real estate through wholly owned subsidiaries and other entities through which it co-invests with partners and investors, having a significant ownership interest in those co-investment ventures which are either consolidated or unconsolidated based on its level of control. At December 31, 2025 it owned or had investments in, on a wholly owned basis or through co-investment ventures, properties and development projects expected to total approximately 1.3 billion square feet.

Palantir Technologies Inc. builds software that empowers organizations to effectively integrate their data, decisions and operations at scale, and it was founded in 2003 and started building software for the intelligence community in the United States to assist in counterterrorism investigations and operations, later working with commercial enterprises that often faced fundamentally similar challenges in working with data. It has built four principal software platforms, Palantir Gotham, Palantir Foundry, Palantir Apollo and its Artificial Intelligence Platform, with Foundry its foundational data operations platform providing core capabilities for data management, logic authoring, systemic mapping development through the Palantir Ontology, analytics and workflow development, and AIP its generative artificial intelligence platform providing secure connectivity to third-party-provided large language models, a development toolchain for building AI-powered agents and automations, and an array of AI-enabled end user applications.

Philip Morris International Inc. is a Virginia holding company incorporated in 1987 that became a U.S. public company listed on the New York Stock Exchange in March 2008, and it is a leading international consumer goods company actively delivering a smoke-free future and evolving its portfolio for the long term to include products outside of the tobacco and nicotine sector. Its current product portfolio primarily consists of cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, nicotine pouch and e-vapor products, and since 2008 it has invested over $16 billion to develop, scientifically substantiate and commercialize innovative smoke-free products for adults who would otherwise continue to smoke, with the goal of completely ending the sale of cigarettes, including building world-class scientific assessment capabilities in pre-clinical systems toxicology, clinical and behavioral research and post-market studies. In November 2022 it acquired Swedish Match AB, a leader in oral nicotine delivery, creating a global smoke-free combination.

The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. is a financial services holding company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and one of the largest diversified financial institutions in the U.S., with businesses engaged in retail banking, corporate and institutional banking and asset management, providing many of its products and services nationally. It is organized around its customers and communities for strong relationships and local delivery of retail and business banking including a full range of lending products, specialized services for corporations and government entities, including corporate banking, real estate finance and asset-based lending, and wealth management and asset management. Its retail branch network is located coast-to-coast, and it also has strategic international offices in four countries outside the U.S., and at December 31, 2025 its consolidated total assets, total deposits and total shareholders' equity were $573.6 billion, $440.9 billion and $60.6 billion, respectively.

description: At Pentair, it helps the world sustainably move, improve and enjoy water, life's most essential resource, and from its residential and commercial water solutions to industrial water management and everything in between, Pentair is an S&P 500 company focused on smart, sustainable water solutions that help its planet and people thrive, with a vision to be the world's most valued sustainable water solutions company for its employees, customers and shareholders. It is an Irish public limited company, and its strategy focuses on growth in its core businesses and strategic initiatives, accelerating digital innovation and technology as well as sustainability investments, expediting growth and driving margin expansion through its Transformation Program, and building a high performance growth culture.

Pinnacle West is an investor-owned electric utility holding company based in Phoenix, Arizona with consolidated assets of approximately $30 billion, deriving essentially all of its revenues and earnings from its principal subsidiary, APS, whose affiliates have provided energy and energy-related products to people and businesses throughout Arizona since 1886. APS is Arizona's largest and longest-serving electric company and generates safe, affordable electricity in 11 of Arizona's 15 counties, and Pinnacle West's other active subsidiaries are El Dorado and PNW Power. Its reportable business segment is its regulated electricity segment, which consists of traditional regulated retail and wholesale electricity businesses, primarily electric service to Native Load customers, and related activities, and includes electricity generation, transmission and distribution conducted primarily through its wholly-owned subsidiary APS.

Insulet Corporation is primarily engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of its proprietary continuous insulin delivery systems for people with insulin-dependent diabetes, and its Omnipod platform includes the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, the Omnipod DASH Insulin Management System and the Omnipod Insulin Management System. It also produces pods for Amgen for use in the Neulasta Onpro kit, a delivery system for Amgen's Neulasta to help reduce the risk of infection after intense chemotherapy. In 2022 it received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance and CE Mark approval under the European Union Medical Device Regulation for Omnipod 5, which is currently available in 19 countries, and in August 2024 it received FDA clearance for an expanded indication of Omnipod 5 for people with type 2 diabetes in the United States.

PPG Industries, Inc., incorporated in Pennsylvania in 1883, manufactures and distributes a broad range of paints, coatings and specialty products, with a vision to be the first-choice partner to meet its customers' evolving needs for innovative paints, coatings and surface solutions to protect and beautify the world, a proud heritage with a demonstrated commitment to innovation, sustainability, community engagement and development of leading-edge products, and it is a global leader that markets and sells in more than 50 countries. It supplies paints, coatings and specialty products to customers serving a wide array of end-uses, including industrial equipment and components, packaging material, aircraft and marine equipment, automotive original equipment, automotive refinish and aftermarket, pavement marking products, as well as coatings for other industrial and consumer products, and its Architectural Coatings segment, for example, primarily supplies a variety of decorative coatings, adhesives, sealants and finishes along with paint strippers, stains and related chemicals under brands including SIGMA, HISTOR, SEIGNEURIE, GUITTET, JOHNSTONES, LEYLAND, DEKORAL, GORI, BONDEX, DANKE! and TIKKURILA.

PPL, headquartered in Allentown, Pennsylvania, is a utility holding company incorporated in 1994 that, through its regulated utility subsidiaries, delivers electricity to customers in Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Virginia and Rhode Island, delivers natural gas to customers in Kentucky and Rhode Island, and generates electricity from power plants in Kentucky. Its principal subsidiaries at December 31, 2025 include PPL Electric, which engages in the regulated transmission and distribution of electricity in Pennsylvania; LKE, a holding company that owns regulated utility operations through its subsidiaries LG&E and KU; RIE, which engages in the regulated transmission, distribution and sale of electricity and regulated distribution and sale of natural gas in Rhode Island; and LG&E, which engages in the regulated generation, transmission, distribution and sale of electricity and regulated distribution and sale of natural gas in Kentucky.

Prudential Financial, Inc. and its subsidiaries provide a wide range of insurance, investment management and other financial products and services to both individual and institutional customers throughout the United States and in many other countries, with principal products and services including life insurance, annuities, retirement solutions, mutual funds and investment management. Its principal operations consist of PGIM, its global investment management business, the U.S. Businesses consisting of the Retirement Strategies, Group Insurance and Individual Life businesses, the International Businesses, the Closed Block division, and its Corporate and Other operations, and the Closed Block division is accounted for as a divested business that is reported separately from the Divested and Run-off Businesses included within Corporate and Other operations.

Public Storage, as the largest owner of self-storage facilities, believes it owns approximately 9 percent of the self-storage square footage in the U.S. and that collectively the four largest self-storage owners in the U.S. own approximately 22 percent, with the remaining 78 percent owned by regional and local operators, and it believes its Public Storage brand awareness, as well as the innovative improvements it has made to the customer experience, provide it with a competitive advantage in acquiring and retaining customers relative to other self-storage operators, in a highly fragmented market for the ownership and operation of self-storage facilities.

Paramount Skydance Corporation is a global media and entertainment company with a portfolio that includes Paramount Pictures, Paramount Television, CBS, CBS News, CBS Sports, Nickelodeon, MTV, BET, Comedy Central, Showtime, Paramount+, Pluto TV and Skydance Media's animation, interactive/games and sports divisions. In 2025 it operated through the segments of TV Media, comprising its domestic and international broadcast networks and owned television stations, domestic cable networks and international extensions of certain of its domestic cable network brands, and domestic and international television studio operations producing and distributing first-run syndicated programming; Direct-to-Consumer, comprising a portfolio of domestic and international pay and free streaming services; and Filmed Entertainment, comprising the production and acquisition of films, series and short-form content for release and licensing around the world. On December 8, 2025 it announced a cash tender offer for all outstanding shares of Series A Common Stock of Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. at $30.00 per share, subject to conditions and scheduled to expire on March 2, 2026 unless further extended.

Phillips 66, headquartered in Houston, Texas, was incorporated in Delaware in 2011 in connection with, and in anticipation of, a restructuring of ConocoPhillips that separated its downstream businesses into an independent, publicly traded company named Phillips 66, the two companies having been separated by ConocoPhillips distributing to its shareholders all the shares of common stock of Phillips 66 after the market closed on April 30, 2012, and its stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the PSX stock symbol. Its businesses are organized into five operating segments, with its Midstream segment providing crude oil and refined petroleum product transportation, terminaling and storage services, as well as natural gas and NGL gathering, processing, transportation, fractionation, storage and marketing services in the United States, and its Chemicals segment consisting of its 50 percent equity investment in Chevron Phillips Chemical.

PTC Inc. is a global software company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, employing over 7,000 people and supporting more than 30,000 customers globally, primarily serving customers in the industry verticals of Industrials, Federal, Aerospace and Defense, Electronics and High Tech, Automotive, and Medical Technology and Life Sciences. Its customers are focused on improving their competitiveness in the face of global competition and increasing product complexity, and its suite of software offerings is a strategic enabler of this and their digital transformation initiatives, with the breadth and openness of its portfolio enabling the Intelligent Product Lifecycle by establishing a strong product data foundation in the engineering department and democratizing the access and use of that data across the enterprise to drive cross-functional collaboration, accelerate new product introduction timelines and deliver higher product quality.

Quanta Services, Inc. is a leading provider of comprehensive infrastructure solutions for the electric and gas utility, power generation, large load center, manufacturing, communications, pipeline and energy industries in the United States, Canada, Australia and select other international markets. It provides design, engineering, procurement, construction, upgrade and repair and maintenance services for infrastructure within each of these industries, including electric power transmission and distribution networks, substation facilities, wind, solar and gas power generation and transmission and battery storage facilities, low voltage electrical, mechanical, plumbing and process infrastructure for large load centers such as data center, advanced manufacturing, healthcare, pharmaceutical and industrial facilities, communications and cable multi-system operator networks, gas utility systems, pipeline transmission systems and facilities, and downstream industrial facilities, and its operations are decentralized.

PayPal Holdings, Inc.'s mission is to revolutionize commerce globally, with products designed to enable digital payments and simplify commerce experiences for consumers and merchants to make selling, shopping, and sending and receiving money simple, personalized and secure, whether online or in-person, and it operates a global, two-sided network at scale that connects consumers and merchants with 439 million active accounts across approximately 200 markets as of December 31, 2025. It provides consumers with digital wallets and other solutions that allow them to shop and pay with PayPal and Venmo both online and in-person, manage their finances including saving and buying and selling cryptocurrencies, and send and receive money between friends and family, and when shopping it offers consumers flexibility in how they pay, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal-branded consumer credit and debit products, other credit and debit cards, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and its business is built on strong competitive strengths including its two-sided platform and trusted brands such as PayPal and Venmo.

Qnity Electronics, Inc. is one of the largest global leaders in materials and solutions for the semiconductor and electronics industries, empowering its customers' technology roadmaps to enable advancements in megatrends such as artificial intelligence, high-performance computing and advanced connectivity. It partners with leading semiconductor and advanced device manufacturers to address complex challenges and develop solutions that facilitate next-generation technological innovations, and with over 50 years of experience in systems engineering and material science, a global manufacturing footprint and major application labs across the world, it is well-positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities across various sectors including data centers, communications infrastructure, industrials, automotive and consumer electronics. On May 22, 2024, DuPont de Nemours, Inc. announced its plan to separate Qnity from DuPont into an independent publicly traded company, and on November 1, 2025 DuPont completed the separation and distribution. It is also a leading supplier of innovative materials and processes for organic light-emitting diode displays, having pioneered advanced OLED materials and launched the first mass-produced red phosphorescent OLED host.

Qualcomm Incorporated, incorporated in California in 1985 and reincorporated in Delaware in 1991, is a global technology leader helping to bring intelligent computing everywhere through the development and commercialization of foundational technologies, including on-device artificial intelligence, high-performance and low-power computing and advanced wireless connectivity. Its platforms help power intelligent devices that people and businesses rely on every day across industries, and it operates and reports using a 52-53 week fiscal year ending on the last Sunday in September, with fiscal years for 2025, 2024 and 2023 including 52 weeks, 53 weeks and 52 weeks, respectively.

Royal Caribbean Group is a vacation industry leader, owning and operating three global cruise vacation brands, Royal Caribbean, Celebrity Cruises and Silversea, and it also owns a 50 percent joint venture interest in TUI Cruises GmbH, which operates the German brands TUI Cruises and Hapag-Lloyd Cruises, accounted for under the equity method of accounting. Together its Global Brands and Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 69 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 179,720 berths as of December 31, 2025, and its ships offer a selection of worldwide itineraries that call on more than 1,000 destinations on all seven continents, with Silversea being an ultra luxury and expedition travel brand featuring smaller ships, high standards of accommodations, fine dining, personalized service and exotic itineraries, operating 12 ships with an aggregate capacity of approximately 5,500 berths, and it also owns a growing portfolio of private land-based destinations, including its Perfect Day and Royal Beach Club collections, with its competitive edge grounded in its focus on innovation, best evidenced in the quality and variety of ships in its fleet.

Reddit, Inc.'s mission is to empower communities and make their knowledge accessible to everyone, and it built Reddit with the belief that communities unlock the power of human creativity and create a sense of belonging and empowerment for their members, with its over 100,000 active communities having channeled the power of human creativity to grow Reddit since its founding, and it believes the world needs community more than ever and that this represents its greatest opportunity to further enrich the lives of everyone in the world. Reddit is a global, digital city where anyone in the world can join a community to learn from one another, engage in authentic conversations, explore passions, research new hobbies, exchange goods and services, create new communities and experiences, share a few laughs, and find belonging, and it turned 20 in 2025, two decades of building a user-powered platform where users bring their honest selves and connect over the topics they care most about.

Regency Centers Corporation is a fully integrated real estate company and self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust that began its operations as a publicly-traded REIT in 1993, with corporate headquarters at One Independent Drive, Suite 114, Jacksonville, Florida, and Regency Centers, L.P. is a subsidiary through which Regency Centers Corporation conducts substantially all of its operations and which owns, directly or indirectly, substantially all of its assets. Its business consists of acquiring, developing, owning and operating income-producing retail real estate principally located in suburban trade areas with compelling demographics within the United States, and it generates revenues by leasing space to necessity, service, convenience and value-based retailers serving the essential needs of its communities, and it has been an S&P 500 Index member since 2017, with full or partial equity ownership interests in 481 properties as of December 31, 2025, and it is among the largest owners of shopping centers in the USA based on revenues, number of properties, GLA and market capitalization.

Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a fully integrated biotechnology company that invents, develops, manufactures and commercializes medicines for people with serious diseases, and its research and development efforts have led to numerous products that have received marketing approval and approximately 45 product candidates currently in clinical development, including a number of marketed products for which it is investigating additional indications, most of which were homegrown in its laboratories, and its ability to generate profits and positive cash flow from operations over the next several years depends significantly on the success in commercializing its products, including EYLEA HD and Dupixent.

Regions Financial Corporation is a financial holding company headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, operating in the South, Midwest and Texas, and in addition operates several offices delivering specialty capabilities in New York, Washington D.C., Chicago, Salt Lake City and other locations nationwide. It provides financial solutions for a wide range of clients including retail and mortgage banking services, commercial banking services and wealth and investment services, and at December 31, 2025 it had total consolidated assets of approximately $158.8 billion, total consolidated deposits of approximately $131.1 billion and total consolidated shareholders' equity of approximately $19.0 billion.

Raymond James Financial, Inc. is a leading diversified financial services company providing private client group, capital markets, asset management, banking and other services to individuals, corporations and municipalities, and the firm, together with its subsidiaries, is engaged in various financial services activities, including providing investment management services to retail and institutional clients, merger and acquisition and advisory services, the underwriting, distribution, trading and brokerage of equity and debt securities, and the sale of mutual funds and other investment products, and also provides corporate and retail banking services and trust services. Established in 1962 and public since 1983, the firm operates predominantly in the United States and, to a lesser extent, in Canada, the United Kingdom and other parts of Europe.

Founded in 1967 by Mr. Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Corporation is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of luxury lifestyle products, including apparel, handbags, footwear and accessories, fragrances, home and hospitality, and for nearly 60 years it has sought to inspire the dream of a better life through authenticity and timeless style, with its long-standing reputation and distinctive image developed across a wide range of products, brands, distribution channels and international markets, and it believes that its global reach, breadth of lifestyle product offerings and multi-channel distribution network are unique among luxury and apparel companies. It diversifies its business by geography, including North America, Europe and Asia, among other regions, and by channel of distribution, retail, wholesale and licensing, maintaining a dynamic balance as its operating results do not depend solely on the performance of any single geographic area or channel of distribution.

ResMed Inc. is a global leader in digital health and cloud-connected medical devices, designing innovative technology to empower people to live happier, healthier lives, and its artificial intelligence powered digital health solutions, cloud-connected devices and intelligent software are designed to make home healthcare more personalized, accessible and effective, with its products improving quality of life, reducing the impact of chronic disease and lowering costs for consumers and healthcare systems by enabling better care. Following its formation in 1989 it commercialized a continuous positive airway pressure treatment for obstructive sleep apnea, the first successful non-invasive treatment for OSA, and since then has expanded its business by developing or acquiring innovative products and solutions for a broad range of sleep and related breathing health needs, and it operates in two segments, the Sleep and Breathing Health segment and the Residential Care Software segment, focusing on sleep and related breathing health markets it believes are globally underpenetrated.

Rockwell Automation, Inc. is the world's largest company dedicated to industrial automation and digital transformation, understanding and simplifying its customers' complex production challenges and delivering the most valued solutions that combine technology and industry expertise, as a result making its customers more resilient, agile and sustainable. The company continues the business founded as the Allen-Bradley Company in 1903, which was a leading North American manufacturer of industrial automation equipment when the former Rockwell International Corporation purchased it in 1985, and it was incorporated in Delaware in connection with a tax-free reorganization completed on December 6, 1996.

Rollins, Inc. is an international services company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and through its family of leading brands it provides essential pest and wildlife control services and protection against termite damage, rodents and insects to more than two million residential and commercial customers from more than 800 Company-owned and franchised locations in approximately 70 countries, with the contracted and recurring nature of its services providing it visibility into a significant portion of its future revenue. In 1964 brothers O. Wayne and John Rollins acquired Orkin Exterminating Company and in 1965 the company changed its name from Rollins Broadcasting, Inc to Rollins, Inc., and in 1968 Rollins began trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol ROL, since then growing into a premier global consumer and commercial services company.

Roper Technologies, Inc. is a diversified technology company with a proven, long-term, successful track record of compounding cash flow and increasing shareholder value, operating market leading businesses that design and develop vertical software and technology enabled products for a variety of defensible niche markets, and it pursues consistent and sustainable growth in revenue, earnings and cash flow by enabling continuous improvement in the operating performance of its businesses and by acquiring businesses that offer high value-added software, services, technology-enabled products and solutions that it believes are capable of realizing growth while maintaining high margins, competing in many defensible niche markets where it believes it is the market leader or a competitive alternative to the market leader in most of them, and in the last three years it has deployed approximately $8,960 of capital toward acquisitions. Its Application Software segment had net revenues of $4,483.0 for the year ended December 31, 2025, representing 56.7 percent of its total net revenues, and includes businesses such as Aderant, providing comprehensive management software and AI-enabled solutions for law and other professional services firms, and CentralReach, providing SaaS and AI-enabled solutions enabling the workflow and administration of ABA therapy for autism spectrum disorders.

Ross Stores, Inc. and its subsidiaries operate two brands of off-price retail apparel and home fashion stores, Ross Dress for Less and dds DISCOUNTS. Ross is the largest off-price apparel and home fashion chain in the United States, with 1,904 locations in 44 states, the District of Columbia, Guam and Puerto Rico as of January 31, 2026, and Ross offers first-quality, in-season, brand name and designer apparel, accessories, footwear and home fashions for the entire family at savings of 20 to 60 percent off department and specialty store regular prices every day, with its target customers primarily from middle income households. It also operates 363 dds DISCOUNTS stores in 22 states as of January 31, 2026, and dds DISCOUNTS features more moderately-priced first-quality, in-season apparel, accessories, footwear and home fashions for the entire family at savings of 20 to 70 percent off moderate department and discount store regular prices every day.

Republic Services is one of the largest providers of environmental services in North America, as measured by revenue, operating across the United States and Canada through 377 collection operations, 255 transfer stations, 79 recycling centers, 207 active landfills, 2 treatment, recovery and disposal facilities, 24 treatment, storage and disposal facilities, 5 salt water disposal wells, 15 deep injection wells, 9 industrial wastewater treatment facilities, and 2 polymer centers, and it is engaged in 84 landfill gas-to-energy and other renewable energy projects and had post-closure responsibility for 124 closed landfills. It believes the total addressable United States and Canada environmental services market in which it operates generates approximately $163 billion of annual revenue, which includes the $110 billion recycling and waste industry, $37 billion of the broader environmental solutions industry, and $16 billion in sustainability innovation and emerging waste and recycling technology.

RTX Corporation is an aerospace and defense company that provides advanced systems and services for commercial, military and government customers worldwide, serving commercial and government customers in both the original equipment and aftermarket parts and services segments of the aerospace industry, and its defense business serves both domestic and international customers as a prime contractor or subcontractor on a broad portfolio of defense and related programs for military and government customers. It was incorporated in Delaware in 1934, and its Raytheon business is a leading provider of defensive and offensive threat detection, tracking and mitigation capabilities for U.S. and foreign government and commercial customers, designing, developing and providing advanced capabilities in integrated air and missile defense, smart weapons, missiles, advanced sensors and radars, interceptors, space-based systems, hypersonics and missile defense across land, air, sea and space, providing air-to-air and air-to-ground sensors, command and control and weapons including the Advanced Medium Range Air-to-Air Missile (AMRAAM) and StormBreaker smart munitions.

Revvity, Inc. is a leading provider of health science solutions, technologies, expertise and services that deliver complete workflows from discovery to development, and from diagnosis to cure, and describes itself as revolutionizing what's possible in healthcare, with specialized focus areas in translational multi-omics technologies, biomarker identification, imaging, prediction, screening, detection and diagnosis, informatics and more. Its headquarters are in Waltham, Massachusetts, and it markets its products and services in more than 160 countries, and as of December 28, 2025 it employed approximately 11,000 employees, with its common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol RVTY and the company a component of the S&P 500 Index. Its products and services include reagents, including radiometric detection solutions with over 750 radiochemicals for use with liquid and plate-based analyzers utilized in research, environmental and drug discovery applications, and reagents and solutions for microscopy and imaging applications, including PhenoVue cellular imaging reagents and cell painting kits, PhenoPlate cellular imaging microplates, GrowDex hydrogels, fluorophore-conjugated and enzyme-conjugated antibodies, and buffers and solutions such as its Ce3D collection for 3D tissue imaging.

SBA Communications Corporation is a leading independent owner and operator of wireless communications infrastructure, including tower structures, rooftops and other structures that support antennas used for wireless communications, which it collectively refers to as towers or sites, with its principal operations in the United States and its territories and additional towers in South America, Central America and Africa. During the year ended December 31, 2025 it sold all of its towers and ended its operations in both the Philippines and Colombia and sold substantially all of its operations in Canada, and its primary business line is its site leasing business, which contributed 97.9 percent of its total segment operating profit for the year ended December 31, 2025, in which it leases space to wireless service providers and other customers on assets that it owns or operates and manages rooftop and tower sites for property owners under various contractual arrangements.

Starbucks Corporation is the premier roaster, marketer and retailer of specialty coffee in the world, operating in 89 markets, and formed in 1985 its common stock trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol SBUX. It purchases and roasts high-quality coffees that it sells, along with handcrafted coffee, tea and other beverages and a variety of high-quality food items through company-operated stores, and also sells a variety of coffee and tea products and licenses its trademarks through other channels, such as licensed stores as well as grocery and foodservice through its Global Coffee Alliance with Nestlé S.A. In addition to its flagship Starbucks Coffee brand, it sells goods and services under the brands Teavana, Ethos and others.

The Charles Schwab Corporation (CSC) is a savings and loan holding company that engages, through its subsidiaries, in wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody and financial advisory services. At December 31, 2025 Schwab had $11.90 trillion in client assets, 38.5 million active brokerage accounts, 5.7 million workplace plan participant accounts and 2.2 million banking accounts. Its principal business subsidiaries include Charles Schwab & Co., Inc., incorporated in 1971 as a securities broker-dealer, Charles Schwab Bank, SSB as its principal banking entity, and Charles Schwab Investment Management, Inc., the investment adviser for Schwab's proprietary mutual funds and exchange-traded funds. On November 6, 2025 Schwab announced a definitive agreement to acquire Forge Global Holdings, Inc., operator of a leading private market platform and trading marketplace, in a transaction valued at approximately $660 million and expected to close in March 2026.

The Sherwin-Williams Company, founded in 1866 and incorporated in Ohio in 1884, is engaged in the development, manufacture, distribution and sale of paint, coatings and related products to professional, industrial, commercial and retail customers primarily in North and South America with additional operations in the Caribbean region, Europe, Asia and Australia, with its principal executive offices located at 1 Sherwin Way, Cleveland, Ohio. In order to meet increased demand during the second and third quarters the company usually builds its inventories during the first quarter, and its working capital items, inventories and accounts receivable, are generally financed through short-term borrowings including lines of credit and the issuance of commercial paper.

The J. M. Smucker Company, established in 1897 and incorporated in Ohio in 1921, operates principally in one industry, the manufacturing and marketing of branded food and beverage products on a worldwide basis, although the majority of its sales are in the United States, with operations outside the U.S. principally in Canada, and net sales outside the U.S. represented 4 percent of consolidated net sales for 2026. Its branded food and beverage products include a strong portfolio of trusted, iconic, market-leading brands sold to consumers primarily through retail outlets in North America, and it has five reportable segments: U.S. Retail Coffee, U.S. Retail Frozen Handheld and Spreads, and U.S. Retail Pet Foods, Sweet Baked Snacks, and Away From Home.

SLB N.V., also known as SLB Limited, is a global technology company driving energy innovation for a balanced planet, with a global presence in more than 100 countries and employees representing almost twice as many nationalities, working each day on innovating energy technology, delivering digital at scale, decarbonizing industries, and developing and scaling new energy systems that accelerate the energy transition, and it is well positioned and committed to being a leader in providing solutions to address the challenge of providing secure and affordable energy while rapidly decarbonizing for a sustainable future. It is primarily organized under four Divisions that combine and integrate SLB's technologies, enhancing its ability to support emerging long-term growth opportunities, with divisions such as Stimulation providing services to restore or enhance well productivity through hydraulic fracturing, matrix stimulation and water treatment, and Intervention providing a comprehensive approach to oil and gas operators to increase intervention success rates and maximize recovery from brownfields through cased hole wireline and perforations, coiled-tubing interventions, slickline and reservoir monitoring.

Super Micro Computer, Inc. is a Silicon Valley-based provider of total information technology solutions which address demanding workloads from the enterprise and cloud to the intelligent edge, delivering rack-scale solutions optimized for various workloads including artificial intelligence and high-performance computing where acceleration is critical, and additionally offering an extensive portfolio of server and storage solutions for enterprise data centers, cloud service providers and edge computing applications such as 5G Telco, Retail and embedded. During fiscal year 2026 it advanced its transformation into a total data center infrastructure provider through its Data Center Building Block Solutions, an integrated offering that delivers complete, modular AI infrastructure from validated components and sub-systems, ranging from individual GPUs and networking switches to complete racks, site infrastructure, management software and professional services, complementing its Total IT Solutions.

Snap-on is a leading global innovator, manufacturer and marketer of tools, equipment, diagnostics, repair information and systems solutions for professional users performing critical tasks including those working in vehicle repair, aerospace, the military, natural resources and manufacturing, and from its founding in 1920 Snap-on has been recognized as the mark of the serious and the outward sign of the pride and dignity working men and women take in their professions. Its products and services are sold through the company's network of widely recognized franchisee vans as well as through direct and distributor channels under a variety of notable brands, and the company also provides financing programs to facilitate the sales of its products and to support its franchise business, marketing its products and brands worldwide in more than 130 countries with its largest geographic market being the United States, and it offers a broad line of products and complementary services grouped into three product categories: tools, diagnostics, information and management systems, and equipment.

Prior to February 21, 2025, Sandisk Corporation was wholly owned by Western Digital Corporation, and as of February 21, 2025 it separated from WDC and became a standalone publicly traded company, trading under the stock symbol SNDK on the Nasdaq Global Select Market. Sandisk is a leading global semiconductor memory company with more than 30 years of innovation in NAND flash technology, and is a vertically integrated solutions provider with ownership of chip-level design and IP, front and back-end manufacturing, as well as systems engineering and design, and its Datacenter end market, a large and growing end market comprised primarily of products for public or private cloud environments and enterprise customers, is provided with an array of high-performance enterprise SSDs, including high-performance flash-based SSDs and software solutions optimized for performance applications providing a range of capacity and performance levels primarily for use in enterprise servers and supporting high-volume online transactions, AI-related workloads, data analysis and other enterprise applications.

Synopsys, Inc. is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products, and it delivers trusted and comprehensive solutions spanning silicon design, silicon intellectual property, simulation and analysis as well as design services, partnering closely with its customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity. It is a global leader in supplying the mission-critical EDA solutions that engineers use to design and test integrated circuits, also known as chips or silicon, and it is pioneering artificial intelligence driven chip design across the full-stack EDA suite to improve efficiency and accelerate the design, verification testing and manufacturing of advanced digital and analog chips, providing software and hardware used to validate the electronic systems that incorporate chips and the software that runs on them, and it helps chip and system engineers and software developers speed up time to market, achieve the highest quality of results, mitigate risk and maximize profitability.

Southern Company is a holding company that owns all of the outstanding common stock of three traditional electric operating companies, Southern Power Company, and Southern Company Gas. The traditional electric operating companies, Alabama Power, Georgia Power and Mississippi Power, are each vertically integrated utilities providing electric service to retail customers in three Southeastern states in addition to wholesale customers in the Southeast. Southern Power Company is an operating public utility company that develops, constructs, acquires, owns, operates and manages power generation assets, including battery energy storage projects, and sells electricity at market-based rates in the wholesale market, and Southern Company Gas is an energy services holding company whose primary business is the distribution of natural gas.

Solventum Corporation is a leading global healthcare company developing, manufacturing and commercializing a broad portfolio of solutions that leverages deep material science, data science and digital capabilities to address critical customer and patient needs, and it constantly seeks to enable the improvement of standards of care and move healthcare forward with innovation powered by insights, clinical intelligence, technology and manufacturing expertise, drawing on a more than 70-year history of discovering and innovating advanced solutions. Its solutions are relied on every day within the global healthcare industry to deliver higher-quality patient care, more efficient processes and workflows, and improved standards of safety and accuracy, and its products and services are present along a patient's journey through prevention, diagnosis, treatment and recovery, and development and protection of its proprietary technologies through intellectual property rights is a strategic priority, relying on a combination of patent, design, utility model, trademark, copyright and trade secret protections as well as regulatory exclusivity periods and confidentiality agreements.

Simon Property Group, Inc. is an Indiana corporation that operates as a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust, or REIT, under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, and Simon Property Group, L.P. is its majority-owned Indiana partnership subsidiary that owns directly or indirectly all of its real estate properties and other assets, and references to Simon mean Simon Property Group, Inc. while references to the Operating Partnership mean Simon Property Group, L.P. and references to we, us and our mean collectively Simon, the Operating Partnership and those entities or subsidiaries owned or controlled by Simon and/or the Operating Partnership. The Operating Partnership also has available a global unsecured commercial paper program of $2.0 billion, or the non-U.S. dollar equivalent thereof.

S&P Global Inc. is a global, diversified and highly differentiated provider of benchmarks, data, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, energy and commodity, and automotive markets. The capital markets include asset managers, investment banks, commercial banks, insurance companies, exchanges, trading firms and issuers; the energy and commodity markets include producers, consumers, traders and intermediaries within energy, chemicals, shipping, metals, carbon and agriculture; and the automotive markets include manufacturers, suppliers, dealerships, service shops and customers. It serves its global customers through a broad range of products and services available through both third-party and proprietary distribution channels, and it was incorporated in December of 1925 under the laws of the state of New York, with its operations consisting of five businesses, including S&P Global Market Intelligence.

Sempra is a holding company whose principal businesses are regulated utilities in California and Texas, investing in and operating electric and gas utilities and other energy infrastructure that provide energy services to customers. Sempra was formed in 1998 through a business combination of Enova Corporation and Pacific Enterprises, the holding companies of its regulated public utilities in California, SDG&E, which began operations in 1881, and SoCalGas, which began operations in 1867, and it has since expanded its regulated public utility presence into Texas through its 80.25 percent interest in Oncor and 50 percent interest in Sharyland Utilities, while Sempra Infrastructure's assets include investments in the U.S. and Mexico with a focus on LNG, energy networks and low carbon solutions, and Sempra's mission is to build America's leading utility growth business.

STERIS plc is a leading global provider of products and services that support patient care with an emphasis on infection prevention, helping its customers create a healthier and safer world by providing innovative healthcare and life science products and services around the globe, offering a unique mix of consumable products such as detergents, endoscopy accessories, barrier products, instruments and tools; services including equipment installation and maintenance, microbial reduction of medical devices, instrument and scope repair, laboratory testing and outsourced reprocessing; capital equipment such as sterilizers, surgical tables and automated endoscope reprocessors; and connectivity solutions such as operating room integration. It operates and reports its financial information in three reportable business segments: Healthcare, Applied Sterilization Technologies and Life Sciences.

Steel Dynamics, Inc. is a leading industrial metals solutions company, with facilities located throughout the United States and Mexico, operating a circular manufacturing model that produces high-quality, lower-carbon-emission products with recycled scrap as the primary input. It is one of the largest domestic steel producers and metals recyclers in North America based on estimated steelmaking and steel coating capacity of approximately 16 million tons and actual metals recycling volumes as of December 31, 2025, with one of the most diversified product and end market portfolios in the domestic steel industry combined with a meaningful downstream steel fabrication platform, and the company also has aluminum operations, further diversifying its product offerings to supply aluminum flat rolled products with higher recycled content to the countercyclical, sustainable beverage can industry, as well as the automotive and industrial sectors.

State Street Corporation is one of the world's leading providers of financial services to institutional investors, including investment servicing, markets and financing solutions and investment management, and its clients, asset managers and owners, insurance companies, wealth managers, official institutions and central banks, rely on it to deliver solutions that support their business objectives across the investment life cycle, with the company working in all aspects of its business toward a singular purpose of helping to create better outcomes for the world's investors and the people they serve. Through its subsidiaries, including its principal banking subsidiary, State Street Bank and Trust Company, it operates in more than 100 geographic markets worldwide, providing a broad range of financial products and services to institutional investors globally.

Seagate is a leading provider of mass-capacity data storage, accelerating the world's ability to harness the full value of data, and for nearly 50 years its portfolio of advanced storage solutions has helped hyperscale, cloud service providers, enterprises and consumers protect, create and manage the data that powers their transformation and growth. Hard disk drives remain a foundational technology for delivering scalable, energy-efficient, mass-capacity storage with favorable storage economics that underpins modern digital infrastructure, and its vertically integrated engineering and manufacturing capabilities, together with continued investment in advanced storage technologies, position it to address customers' evolving storage requirements. It designs and manufactures HDDs, storage systems and related solutions serving two principal end markets, Data Center, which comprises cloud and enterprise environments that rely on scalable, high-capacity storage infrastructure to support AI-enabled computing, business-critical applications and other data-intensive workloads, and other markets.
